input.title: Dwaar Ka Rakshak
input.script_text: EXT. SURYAGARH CITADEL - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) Characters: Agnivesh, Maharaja Someshwar, Prince Ranvijay, Rajguru Badrinath, Devika, Royal Guard 1, Royal Guard 2 On the wide temple steps, Maharaja Someshwar stands at the top with Rajguru Badrinath and Ranvijay beside him. A few steps below, Royal Guards 1 and 2 hold Agnivesh by the arms. Devika stands to one side of the steps, between them. VIOLET THUNDER splits the sky again; the crack in the golden RAKSHA-KAVACH dome spreads farther from the north. At the Maharaja's shoulder, Rajguru Badrinath watches Agnivesh, hands calmly folded. MAHARAJA SOMESHWAR turns to the royal guards. MAHARAJA SOMESHWAR (furious, pointing at Agnivesh) Yeh khatra is ashubh Agnivesh ki wajah se hi aaya hai! Yeh kaala sankat isi ke paap ka parinaam hai! ROYAL GUARD 1 and ROYAL GUARD 2 tighten their grip on Agnivesh's arms. He looks at them but does not resist. Devika steps forward. DEVIKA (pleading, firm) Nahi Maharaj! Agnivesh nirdosh hain. Dand dena hi hai toh us gaddaar ko dijiye jisne mahal ke bheetar se uttari dwaar toda! MAHARAJA SOMESHWAR (grave, thundering) Bas, Devika! Is kul-kalank ka paksh lene ki bhool mat karo... anyatha iske saath tumhein bhi is Rajmahal se nishkaasit kar diya jaayega! The guards march Agnivesh down the temple steps and across the citadel toward the ROYAL ARCHIVE TOWER. Devika follows. Ranvijay stays behind, gripping the ANCESTRAL SWORD. INT. ROYAL ARCHIVE TOWER - STAIRWELL - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) Characters: Agnivesh, Devika, Royal Guard 1, Royal Guard 2 ROYAL GUARD 1 and ROYAL GUARD 2 march Agnivesh up the stone stairs, each gripping one of his arms, a spear in the other hand. Devika follows close behind with her brass compass. On the way up, Agnivesh notices three large WARNING CONCHES mounted on brass brackets at the foot of the stairs. They are silent. AGNIVESH (low, steady) Chetaavani-Shankh kyun nahi goonje? Unke naad ke bina shatru dwaar tak kaise pahunch gaya? Devika raises one hand toward the guards. They release his arms and step back a few stairs up, but stay close. Devika sits on a step, takes the folded CELESTIAL WARD MAP from a pouch at her waist and opens it on the step. Agnivesh sits beside her. Devika places her brass compass in the centre of the parchment map. The compass needle spins, then points to the map. Seven gate symbols appear around Suryagarh. Six glow gold. The northern gate is black. A thin violet line runs from the black gate straight to the symbol for Surya Mandir. Devika follows the line with her finger and turns the map toward Agnivesh. DEVIKA (low, urgent) Uttari Raksha-Dwaar ki yeh rekha seedhe Surya Mandir se judi hai... kisi ne mandir ke bheetar se hi Raksha-Kavach ko nishkriya kiya hai! AGNIVESH (grim, realising) Toh shatru ko jal-maarg se laane mein, Rajmahal ke andar ka hi koi vishwasghati mila hua hai. Devika folds the map and holds it out to Agnivesh. DEVIKA (urgent, pleading) Shatru raj-dwaar tak pahunch chuka hai, Agnivesh! Yeh naksha lo aur jitna shighra ho sake, Suryagarh se nikal jao... yahan ka darbar tumhe sirf ashubh balak hi samjhega! Agnivesh refuses to take it. AGNIVESH (quiet, resolute) Main apni janm-bhoomi aur apni praja ko chhodkar kahin nahi jaunga... Agnivesh rises, determined, his eyes on the Rajmahal through the stairwell's open arch. AGNIVESH (firm) Chahe Maharaj mujhe mrityu-dand hi kyun na de dein! Devika rises too, the map and compass in her hands, frustrated, her eyes on Agnivesh. DEVIKA (frustrated, pleading) Zinda rahoge tabhi toh is rajya ki raksha kar paoge, Agnivesh! Darbar ne tumhe nishkaasit kar diya hai... yahan rehna maut ko aamantran dena hai! Agnivesh looks into her eyes and speaks softly. AGNIVESH (soft, steady) Darbar ne nishkaasit kiya hai, Devika... Praja ne nahi! Pitashri ne keval mera naam mitaaya hai, Suryagarh ke prati meri zimmedari nahi! Suddenly, a horn blares from the harbour. EXT. HARBOR BARRACKS GATE - NIGHT (POV FROM ARCHIVE TOWER) Characters: Agnivesh, Devika, Royal Sentries, Shadow Hounds From the tower's open arch, Agnivesh and Devika look down at the shore and the HARBOR BARRACKS GATE, which guards the road up to the Archive Tower. ROYAL SENTRIES in bronze armour defend it with swords, spears and shields. SHADOW HOUNDS race across the shore on all fours. Their black, smoke-like fur trails behind them; violet eyes glow beneath lowered brows. They leap at the sentries, snapping their iron fangs and slashing with their claws. A sentry thrusts his spear at one hound. It dodges, bites the spear shaft and tears it from his hands. Another shadow hound knocks a sentry down and pins his shield with its claws. The sentries fight back, but the shadow hounds force them toward the open gate. INT. ROYAL ARCHIVE TOWER - STAIRWELL - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) Characters: Agnivesh, Devika, Royal Guard 1, Royal Guard 2 Agnivesh turns to ROYAL GUARD 1 and ROYAL GUARD 2. AGNIVESH (urgent, commanding) Suryagarh par mahasankat aa chuka hai! Rakshako, chalo mere saath... Shatru ko rajya ki seema mein pravesh karne se rokna hoga! The two guards lower their heads. ROYAL GUARD 1 (stiff, cold) Maaf kijiye, Rajkumar... Hum sena ke sipahi hain, kisi ashubh kul-kalank ke sevak nahi! Hum keval Maharaj aur Yuvraj Ranvijay ka aadesh maante hain, ek shraapit aur apshaguni balak ka nahi! Agnivesh snatches the spear from ROYAL GUARD 1 and turns to go down. Devika steps in front of him, blocking the stairs. DEVIKA (urgent, voice catching) Ruko, Agnivesh! Apne vaham mein mat jiyo! Akele jaoge toh wah Chhaya-Pashu tumhein zinda chaba jayenge... Aur jinhe bachaane jaa rahe ho, wah tumhari maut par bhi tumhein 'apshagun' hi kahenge! AGNIVESH (low, final) Apshagun hi sahi, Devika... kintu yadi meri bali se is rajya ki raksha hoti hai, toh isse bada aashirvaad mere liye aur kuch nahi hoga! Agnivesh runs down the stairs, the spear in hand, toward the HARBOR BARRACKS GATE. Devika tucks the CELESTIAL WARD MAP back into the pouch at her waist and races down after him. EXT. HARBOR BARRACKS GATE - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) Characters: Agnivesh, Devika, Royal Sentry, Royal Sentries, Shadow Hounds The HARBOR BARRACKS stand beside the seashore. Their gate, the HARBOR BARRACKS GATE, guards the shore road up to the Royal Archive Tower. Outside the barracks gate, three royal sentries fight the shadow hounds. The Shadow Hounds rush at them, snapping their iron fangs and slashing with their claws. One Shadow hound knocks a sentry down and bites his lower leg. It drags him across the stones. He screams and drops his sword. Another shadow hound pins a sentry’s arm with its claws, then bites through his sleeve and pulls him away from his weapon. The third sentry backs toward the gate. He raises his sword, but his hands shake. Agnivesh races down the shore road from the Archive Tower, coming up behind the sentries, spear in hand. Devika follows. A shadow hound turns toward the last standing sentry and leaps at him, jaws wide open. The Royal sentry sees it above him. His sword slips from his hand. He shuts his eyes. Agnivesh throws his spear from behind him. It flies past the Royal sentry and pierces the shadow hound through the chest. The beast’s jaws snap shut just before they reach the sentry. The shadow hound crashes onto the stones at the royal sentry’s feet. Black smoke pours from its mouth. The other shadow hounds stop and stare at the fallen beast. Devika stands by the gate, frozen in shock. The sentry turns to Agnivesh behind him. ROYAL SENTRY (shouting, terrified) Rajkumar Agnivesh! Saare shastra vyarth ho chuke hain... yeh rakt-pyaase pashu kisi bhi shastra se nahi ruk rahe! Agnivesh hauls up the bitten sentry and helps him toward the gate. Devika snaps out of her shock and helps the second wounded sentry through the entrance. AGNIVESH (loud, commanding) Aahat sainikon ko surakshit bheetar le jao aur rajya ke pratyek pravesh-dwaar ko andar se band kar do! Another hound lands on the barracks wall. Its claws split the carved stone and shower the path with fragments. ROYAL SENTRY (panting, panicked) Suryagarh ke mahaveer Yuvraj Ranvijay kahan hain?! Is mahasankat ki ghadi mein humein marne ke liye chhod diya hai?! Agnivesh pulls an IRON SPEAR from a weapon rack on the barracks wall and turns toward the hounds. AGNIVESH (deep, hard) Kisi ka intezaar vyarth hai! Yahi samay hai swayam rakshak banne ka... Apni bhujaon par vishwas karo aur apne logon ko bachao! The sentries carry the wounded through the gate. Devika helps one of them, the CELESTIAL WARD MAP safe in the pouch at her waist. Agnivesh plants himself outside the gate, spear level, between the hounds and the entrance. He paces slowly from one side of the gateway to the other, glaring at the SHADOW HOUNDS. AGNIVESH (cold, clear) Suryagarh ke baahar tumhara raaj hoga... Par jab tak meri saansen chal rahi hain, is dwaar ke bheetar pravesh karne ka vichar bhi— One SHADOW HOUND charges straight at Agnivesh. Two more leap at him at the same time—one from his left and one from his right. Agnivesh thrusts his spear into the first hound’s open mouth. He drives the spear into the ground. The hound dies, its body hanging on the spear. The other two hounds are still in the air. Agnivesh's right sleeve slides back: the SWORD-SHAPED MARK blazes molten gold. He raises his wrist toward them. Golden fire bursts from the mark and turns both hounds to ash before they reach him. Devika and the Royal Sentries stare in shock. AGNIVESH (warning) Bheetar ek kadam bhi badhaya, toh raakh mein badal dunga tum sabko! Seeing their fallen packmate impaled on the spear, the remaining Shadow Hounds hesitate—then retreat into the darkness. Far beyond the hounds, on a black rock at the water's edge, a pair of violet eyes watches. A woman's silhouette (KAALINI) turns away into the mist. HARD CUT

output.section_text:
④ Scene-by-Scene Emotion & Camera Intent
Scene 1: EXT. SURYAGARH CITADEL - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) (Shots 1–10 / 48s)
Emotional Target: The court's fear turned into blame; a public verdict without a trial.
Atmosphere Direction: Ominous, windswept, the sky breaking overhead.
Camera Intent:
The sky (1–2): a follow shot along the leading edge of the crack (Raksha-Kavach Cracked (Violet Thunder)), first frame matching Ep 3's last frames; a slow pull back over the citadel (Suryagarh Citadel).
The court (3): a slow crane up the steps from the lower steps (Temple Steps, Low Angle).
The plant (4): a slow push-in on Badrinath, hands folded, no staff.
The accusation (5): a slow arc as Someshwar turns to the guards and points.
The grip (6): a slow push-in from the king's eyeline down onto Agnivesh, the city behind.
The plea and the reply (7–8): low push-in on Devika; a slow dolly back as Someshwar takes one step down toward her.
The exit (9): a slow crane up and back over Ranvijay's shoulder as the procession crosses the citadel toward the tower.
Spatial Staging & Distance: Someshwar at the top, Badrinath at his shoulder, Ranvijay beside them (screen-left, top); Agnivesh held a few steps below (Guard 1 on his left arm, Guard 2 on his right), screen-right; Devika on the steps between the two groups; Royal Courtiers in depth by the doors. The guards' swords are sheathed and they carry no spears yet.
Acting Notes:
Someshwar: Cold fury, sure he is protecting the kingdom. One step down at "Bas, Devika!", no more.
Devika: Firm, not hysterical; she names the traitor inside.
Agnivesh: Looks at the guards' hands, does not resist, says nothing.
Badrinath: Silent, hands folded.
Ranvijay: Grips the Ancestral Sword's hilt as the procession leaves; not drawn.
Lighting Plan: Warm fire-bowl key, cool moonlight, the golden dome glow and the violet crack flickering as a rim; violet thunder flashes on 1.
Scene 2: INT. ROYAL ARCHIVE TOWER - STAIRWELL - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) (Shots 11–23 / 80s)
Emotional Target: Suspicion turning into proof, then a quiet, unshakeable choice.
Atmosphere Direction: Hushed, echoing, intimate; sea wind through the arch.
Camera Intent:
The climb (11): a slow crane up the stairwell after them (Royal Archive Tower).
The conches (12): locked-off close-up with a rack focus from the conches up to Agnivesh.
The question (13): low push-in, the guards' spear shafts at the frame edges.
The landing (14): a slow track-in as they sit on the step under the arch (Top Landing Arch Over the Harbour).
The map (15): a top-down crane down onto the map and compass at 100mm.
The truth (16–17): a push-in on Devika reading the line; a track-in from a full shot to his medium close-up as he realises.
The argument (18–21): an arc from the guards' side as she holds out the map; a low crane up as he rises; a push-in on her frustration; a track-in on the profile two-shot for his soft answer.
The horn (22): a slow track back from the arch as both turn to it.
Spatial Staging & Distance: Devika screen-left and Agnivesh screen-right, sitting side by side on one step; Guards 1 and 2 a few stairs above, each with an Iron Spear; the arch upper-right with the harbour and the Rajmahal beyond.
Acting Notes: Agnivesh quiet, the anger held down, resolve not heroics; Devika urgent and scared for him, frustration, not anger; the guards impersonal, eyes forward.
Lighting Plan: Warm torchlight on the stairs, cool moonlight through the arch as rim and fill; the violet line and the gold gate symbols on the map light her fingertip (15–16).
Scene 3: EXT. HARBOR BARRACKS GATE - NIGHT (POV FROM ARCHIVE TOWER) (Shots 24–32 / 23s)
Emotional Target: Shock: the enemy is already at the gate.
Atmosphere Direction: Distant chaos carried up on the wind, then close, brutal speed.
Camera Intent: A slow push-in over their shoulders through the arch (22, High Angle From the Archive Tower); a slow tilt up a stalking hound (25); then FAST 1–7 (26–32): fast lateral track, quick push, snap tilt, handheld wrench, crash-in, a drop onto the pinned shield, a crane up on the sentries driven back.
Spatial Staging & Distance: The three sentries with their backs to the gate; the hounds coming from the beach. All three sentries use the one Royal Sentry card.
Lighting Plan: Cool moonlight on the sea and sand, warm wall torches at the gate, sea mist, violet hound eyes and purple hound smoke.
Scene 4: INT. ROYAL ARCHIVE TOWER - STAIRWELL - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) (Shots 33–40 / 48s)
Emotional Target: Abandonment by his own soldiers, and the decision to go alone.
Atmosphere Direction: Tense, cold; the horn still echoing.
Camera Intent:
The command (33): a circular track around Agnivesh as he turns from the arch to the guards.
The refusal (34–35): a low push-in on Guard 1's lowered head, then over Agnivesh's shoulder.
The spear (36): a quick follow as he snatches Guard 1's spear and turns down (FAST 8).
The block (37–38): over his shoulder, high angle down the well as Devika steps in front of him (Stairwell Looking Down to the Conches); close on her wet eyes.
The answer (39): a near-static low close-up on his final answer.
The run (40): a handheld follow behind Devika as she tucks the map away and runs down after him.
Spatial Staging & Distance: The guards above on the stairs; Agnivesh and Devika below them. From 34 Agnivesh holds Guard 1's spear; Guard 1 is empty-handed, Guard 2 keeps his. The guards stay behind.
Acting Notes: Guard 1 stiff and cold, duty not cruelty; Devika's voice catches, fear for him, not doubt; Agnivesh low and final.
Lighting Plan: As Scene 2.
Scene 5: EXT. HARBOR BARRACKS GATE - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) (Shots 41–79 / 133s)
Emotional Target: Desperation turning into awe, then dread.
Atmosphere Direction: Brutal, close, wet stone and surf; then the eerie stillness of the retreat.
Camera Intent:
The overrun (41–48): FAST 9–13 (a push toward the gate, a low track with the stalking hound, a snap tilt with the swipe, a snap zoom on the bite, a handheld lateral track with the drag), then a locked-off insert of the dropped sword and a slow crane down on the pinned sentry.
The arrival and the throw (49–53): a low push-in up the shore road; FAST 14–17, the leap, the speed-ramp throw, the snap back.
The stillness (54–59): locked-off at ground level on the reverse as the hound lands dead (Reverse From the Gate Toward the Shore); a slow drift over the smoke from its mouth; locked-off on the staring pack, on Devika, and on the sentry's trembling face.
The cries and the command (60–67): a track-in on the sentry; a track back with Agnivesh and the wounded; a tilt up to the hound on the wall and a drift down the splitting stone; a crane up as he pulls a spear from the rack; a crane down over the hounds' backs as he paces across the gateway.
The climax (68–75): the warning cut off; FAST 18–24 as described above.

input.title: Dwaar Ka Rakshak
input.script_text: EXT. SURYAGARH CITADEL - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) Characters: Agnivesh, Maharaja Someshwar, Prince Ranvijay, Rajguru Badrinath, Devika, Royal Guard 1, Royal Guard 2 On the wide temple steps, Maharaja Someshwar stands at the top with Rajguru Badrinath and Ranvijay beside him. A few steps below, Royal Guards 1 and 2 hold Agnivesh by the arms. Devika stands to one side of the steps, between them. VIOLET THUNDER splits the sky again; the crack in the golden RAKSHA-KAVACH dome spreads farther from the north. At the Maharaja's shoulder, Rajguru Badrinath watches Agnivesh, hands calmly folded. MAHARAJA SOMESHWAR turns to the royal guards. MAHARAJA SOMESHWAR (furious, pointing at Agnivesh) Yeh khatra is ashubh Agnivesh ki wajah se hi aaya hai! Yeh kaala sankat isi ke paap ka parinaam hai! ROYAL GUARD 1 and ROYAL GUARD 2 tighten their grip on Agnivesh's arms. He looks at them but does not resist. Devika steps forward. DEVIKA (pleading, firm) Nahi Maharaj! Agnivesh nirdosh hain. Dand dena hi hai toh us gaddaar ko dijiye jisne mahal ke bheetar se uttari dwaar toda! MAHARAJA SOMESHWAR (grave, thundering) Bas, Devika! Is kul-kalank ka paksh lene ki bhool mat karo... anyatha iske saath tumhein bhi is Rajmahal se nishkaasit kar diya jaayega! The guards march Agnivesh down the temple steps and across the citadel toward the ROYAL ARCHIVE TOWER. Devika follows. Ranvijay stays behind, gripping the ANCESTRAL SWORD. INT. ROYAL ARCHIVE TOWER - STAIRWELL - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) Characters: Agnivesh, Devika, Royal Guard 1, Royal Guard 2 ROYAL GUARD 1 and ROYAL GUARD 2 march Agnivesh up the stone stairs, each gripping one of his arms, a spear in the other hand. Devika follows close behind with her brass compass. On the way up, Agnivesh notices three large WARNING CONCHES mounted on brass brackets at the foot of the stairs. They are silent. AGNIVESH (low, steady) Chetaavani-Shankh kyun nahi goonje? Unke naad ke bina shatru dwaar tak kaise pahunch gaya? Devika raises one hand toward the guards. They release his arms and step back a few stairs up, but stay close. Devika sits on a step, takes the folded CELESTIAL WARD MAP from a pouch at her waist and opens it on the step. Agnivesh sits beside her. Devika places her brass compass in the centre of the parchment map. The compass needle spins, then points to the map. Seven gate symbols appear around Suryagarh. Six glow gold. The northern gate is black. A thin violet line runs from the black gate straight to the symbol for Surya Mandir. Devika follows the line with her finger and turns the map toward Agnivesh. DEVIKA (low, urgent) Uttari Raksha-Dwaar ki yeh rekha seedhe Surya Mandir se judi hai... kisi ne mandir ke bheetar se hi Raksha-Kavach ko nishkriya kiya hai! AGNIVESH (grim, realising) Toh shatru ko jal-maarg se laane mein, Rajmahal ke andar ka hi koi vishwasghati mila hua hai. Devika folds the map and holds it out to Agnivesh. DEVIKA (urgent, pleading) Shatru raj-dwaar tak pahunch chuka hai, Agnivesh! Yeh naksha lo aur jitna shighra ho sake, Suryagarh se nikal jao... yahan ka darbar tumhe sirf ashubh balak hi samjhega! Agnivesh refuses to take it. AGNIVESH (quiet, resolute) Main apni janm-bhoomi aur apni praja ko chhodkar kahin nahi jaunga... Agnivesh rises, determined, his eyes on the Rajmahal through the stairwell's open arch. AGNIVESH (firm) Chahe Maharaj mujhe mrityu-dand hi kyun na de dein! Devika rises too, the map and compass in her hands, frustrated, her eyes on Agnivesh. DEVIKA (frustrated, pleading) Zinda rahoge tabhi toh is rajya ki raksha kar paoge, Agnivesh! Darbar ne tumhe nishkaasit kar diya hai... yahan rehna maut ko aamantran dena hai! Agnivesh looks into her eyes and speaks softly. AGNIVESH (soft, steady) Darbar ne nishkaasit kiya hai, Devika... Praja ne nahi! Pitashri ne keval mera naam mitaaya hai, Suryagarh ke prati meri zimmedari nahi! Suddenly, a horn blares from the harbour. EXT. HARBOR BARRACKS GATE - NIGHT (POV FROM ARCHIVE TOWER) Characters: Agnivesh, Devika, Royal Sentries, Shadow Hounds From the tower's open arch, Agnivesh and Devika look down at the shore and the HARBOR BARRACKS GATE, which guards the road up to the Archive Tower. ROYAL SENTRIES in bronze armour defend it with swords, spears and shields. SHADOW HOUNDS race across the shore on all fours. Their black, smoke-like fur trails behind them; violet eyes glow beneath lowered brows. They leap at the sentries, snapping their iron fangs and slashing with their claws. A sentry thrusts his spear at one hound. It dodges, bites the spear shaft and tears it from his hands. Another shadow hound knocks a sentry down and pins his shield with its claws. The sentries fight back, but the shadow hounds force them toward the open gate. INT. ROYAL ARCHIVE TOWER - STAIRWELL - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) Characters: Agnivesh, Devika, Royal Guard 1, Royal Guard 2 Agnivesh turns to ROYAL GUARD 1 and ROYAL GUARD 2. AGNIVESH (urgent, commanding) Suryagarh par mahasankat aa chuka hai! Rakshako, chalo mere saath... Shatru ko rajya ki seema mein pravesh karne se rokna hoga! The two guards lower their heads. ROYAL GUARD 1 (stiff, cold) Maaf kijiye, Rajkumar... Hum sena ke sipahi hain, kisi ashubh kul-kalank ke sevak nahi! Hum keval Maharaj aur Yuvraj Ranvijay ka aadesh maante hain, ek shraapit aur apshaguni balak ka nahi! Agnivesh snatches the spear from ROYAL GUARD 1 and turns to go down. Devika steps in front of him, blocking the stairs. DEVIKA (urgent, voice catching) Ruko, Agnivesh! Apne vaham mein mat jiyo! Akele jaoge toh wah Chhaya-Pashu tumhein zinda chaba jayenge... Aur jinhe bachaane jaa rahe ho, wah tumhari maut par bhi tumhein 'apshagun' hi kahenge! AGNIVESH (low, final) Apshagun hi sahi, Devika... kintu yadi meri bali se is rajya ki raksha hoti hai, toh isse bada aashirvaad mere liye aur kuch nahi hoga! Agnivesh runs down the stairs, the spear in hand, toward the HARBOR BARRACKS GATE. Devika tucks the CELESTIAL WARD MAP back into the pouch at her waist and races down after him. EXT. HARBOR BARRACKS GATE - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) Characters: Agnivesh, Devika, Royal Sentry, Royal Sentries, Shadow Hounds The HARBOR BARRACKS stand beside the seashore. Their gate, the HARBOR BARRACKS GATE, guards the shore road up to the Royal Archive Tower. Outside the barracks gate, three royal sentries fight the shadow hounds. The Shadow Hounds rush at them, snapping their iron fangs and slashing with their claws. One Shadow hound knocks a sentry down and bites his lower leg. It drags him across the stones. He screams and drops his sword. Another shadow hound pins a sentry’s arm with its claws, then bites through his sleeve and pulls him away from his weapon. The third sentry backs toward the gate. He raises his sword, but his hands shake. Agnivesh races down the shore road from the Archive Tower, coming up behind the sentries, spear in hand. Devika follows. A shadow hound turns toward the last standing sentry and leaps at him, jaws wide open. The Royal sentry sees it above him. His sword slips from his hand. He shuts his eyes. Agnivesh throws his spear from behind him. It flies past the Royal sentry and pierces the shadow hound through the chest. The beast’s jaws snap shut just before they reach the sentry. The shadow hound crashes onto the stones at the royal sentry’s feet. Black smoke pours from its mouth. The other shadow hounds stop and stare at the fallen beast. Devika stands by the gate, frozen in shock. The sentry turns to Agnivesh behind him. ROYAL SENTRY (shouting, terrified) Rajkumar Agnivesh! Saare shastra vyarth ho chuke hain... yeh rakt-pyaase pashu kisi bhi shastra se nahi ruk rahe! Agnivesh hauls up the bitten sentry and helps him toward the gate. Devika snaps out of her shock and helps the second wounded sentry through the entrance. AGNIVESH (loud, commanding) Aahat sainikon ko surakshit bheetar le jao aur rajya ke pratyek pravesh-dwaar ko andar se band kar do! Another hound lands on the barracks wall. Its claws split the carved stone and shower the path with fragments. ROYAL SENTRY (panting, panicked) Suryagarh ke mahaveer Yuvraj Ranvijay kahan hain?! Is mahasankat ki ghadi mein humein marne ke liye chhod diya hai?! Agnivesh pulls an IRON SPEAR from a weapon rack on the barracks wall and turns toward the hounds. AGNIVESH (deep, hard) Kisi ka intezaar vyarth hai! Yahi samay hai swayam rakshak banne ka... Apni bhujaon par vishwas karo aur apne logon ko bachao! The sentries carry the wounded through the gate. Devika helps one of them, the CELESTIAL WARD MAP safe in the pouch at her waist. Agnivesh plants himself outside the gate, spear level, between the hounds and the entrance. He paces slowly from one side of the gateway to the other, glaring at the SHADOW HOUNDS. AGNIVESH (cold, clear) Suryagarh ke baahar tumhara raaj hoga... Par jab tak meri saansen chal rahi hain, is dwaar ke bheetar pravesh karne ka vichar bhi— One SHADOW HOUND charges straight at Agnivesh. Two more leap at him at the same time—one from his left and one from his right. Agnivesh thrusts his spear into the first hound’s open mouth. He drives the spear into the ground. The hound dies, its body hanging on the spear. The other two hounds are still in the air. Agnivesh's right sleeve slides back: the SWORD-SHAPED MARK blazes molten gold. He raises his wrist toward them. Golden fire bursts from the mark and turns both hounds to ash before they reach him. Devika and the Royal Sentries stare in shock. AGNIVESH (warning) Bheetar ek kadam bhi badhaya, toh raakh mein badal dunga tum sabko! Seeing their fallen packmate impaled on the spear, the remaining Shadow Hounds hesitate—then retreat into the darkness. Far beyond the hounds, on a black rock at the water's edge, a pair of violet eyes watches. A woman's silhouette (KAALINI) turns away into the mist. HARD CUT

output.section_text:
⑤ Sound Direction
Concrete Environmental & Foley SFX:

Scene 1: Violet thunder cracking and a glassy splitting along the shell; wind whipping the fire bowls; armour creaking as the grip tightens; boots on stone steps.
Scenes 2 and 4: Footsteps and armour echoing in the stairwell; torch crackle; parchment unfolding; the compass needle whirring; sea wind through the arch; the harbour horn; a spear wrenched from a hand; running feet down the stairs.
Scene 3: Wind at height; snarls, claws on bronze, splintering spear shafts and shouts.
Scene 5: Surf; snarls and growls; claws on stone; a spear whistling through the slow motion and a deep wet thud; the hiss of the dead hound's smoke; stone splitting on the wall; the bullet-time drop to a low heartbeat and stretched snarls; a deep roar of golden fire and an ash hiss; retreating paws on sand.
Silence Strategy: Silence around the conches (12). The throw (52) drops the sound away to the spear's whistle. The pack's sudden silence at 56. The bullet-time orbit (71) is a heartbeat and stretched snarls. The last shot (79) is surf and a low violet hum rising, then silence and HARD CUT to black. Audio in every prompt: Hindi exactly as written in Devanagari, lip-synced, only the named speaker talks; tracks with no lines say so. No music cue is written into the prompts.

⑥ Transitions & Visual Continuity
Inter-Scene Transitions:

Ep 3 to Scene 1: Ep 3 ends under the cracked dome. Ep 4 opens on the same sky, the crack spreading farther.
Scene 1 to Scene 2: The procession leaves the steps (9); straight cut to the tower stairwell (11).
Scene 2 to Scene 3: The horn and both turning to the arch (22) cut to the POV through the arch (24).
Scene 3 to Scene 4: Back from the POV to the landing as he turns to the guards (33).
Scene 4 to Scene 5: The run down the stairs (40) cuts to the barracks under attack (41).
Climax: Kaalini turns away on the rock; HARD CUT to black. No freeze-frame, no fade.
Visual Continuity Anchors:

Agnivesh's Attire: Scorched Cuff + Throat Nick in every shot: the scorched right cuff pulled down, no mark visible, the thin nick at the throat. No scabbard. The Ancient Book does not appear.
Weapons: None until 36 (Guard 1's Iron Spear); thrown at 52 and left in the hound; empty-handed after; a fresh Iron Spear from the rack at 65; planted through the hound at 72–73, staying planted through 79.
The Mark: Hidden until 74. From 68 the sleeve is back and the mark blazes (Scorched Cuff Glowing Mark), still glowing at 76–78. Ep 5 opens in this state.
Guards 1 and 2: Swords sheathed throughout. No spears in Sc 1; Iron Spears from Sc 2. Guard 1 on his left arm, Guard 2 on his right, until released at 14. Guard 1 is empty-handed from 36. They stay in the tower.
Devika: Devika's Dagger as her only weapon, never drawn. The Brass Compass in her hand through Sc 2/4. The Celestial Ward Map comes out of her waist pouch at 14 and goes back into the pouch at 40, where it stays.
Someshwar, Badrinath, Ranvijay and the courtiers: Sc 1 only. Someshwar's hands are empty; Badrinath has no staff; Ranvijay carries only the Ancestral Sword, sheathed.
Royal Sentries: One Royal Sentry card for all three, in the same harbour livery; the speaker is the third, last-standing one. Sentry 1: stalked, bitten and dragged (42–45), drops his sword (#1) on the stones (46), hauled up by Agnivesh where he was dragged (61), sits against the gate post (76); sentry 2: knocked down, shield pinned (30–31), arm pinned and sleeve torn (47), steadied by Devika in the gateway with a bloodied arm (76); sentry 3 (the speaker): his sword (#2) slips at 51, he takes it back at 67 and holds it at 76.
The Hounds: Violet eyes, purple smoke. One dies on the thrown spear (52–55), one on the planted spear (72–73), two turn to ash (75), and the rest retreat (77). Hound #1 dissolves into purple smoke at 57 and spear #1 drops on the stones; the impaled hound stays on spear #2 to the end and dissolves in Ep 5, shot 5. The wall hound (62–63) rejoins the pack at 67; the pack is six or seven, three attack, three or four retreat.
The Dome: Cracked from the north and spreading at 1; the cracked dome with violet thunder overhead in the harbour wides of Sc 3/5.
Kaalini: Silhouette and violet eyes only, at 79.

input.title: Dwaar Ka Rakshak
input.script_text: EXT. SURYAGARH CITADEL - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) Characters: Agnivesh, Maharaja Someshwar, Prince Ranvijay, Rajguru Badrinath, Devika, Royal Guard 1, Royal Guard 2 On the wide temple steps, Maharaja Someshwar stands at the top with Rajguru Badrinath and Ranvijay beside him. A few steps below, Royal Guards 1 and 2 hold Agnivesh by the arms. Devika stands to one side of the steps, between them. VIOLET THUNDER splits the sky again; the crack in the golden RAKSHA-KAVACH dome spreads farther from the north. At the Maharaja's shoulder, Rajguru Badrinath watches Agnivesh, hands calmly folded. MAHARAJA SOMESHWAR turns to the royal guards. MAHARAJA SOMESHWAR (furious, pointing at Agnivesh) Yeh khatra is ashubh Agnivesh ki wajah se hi aaya hai! Yeh kaala sankat isi ke paap ka parinaam hai! ROYAL GUARD 1 and ROYAL GUARD 2 tighten their grip on Agnivesh's arms. He looks at them but does not resist. Devika steps forward. DEVIKA (pleading, firm) Nahi Maharaj! Agnivesh nirdosh hain. Dand dena hi hai toh us gaddaar ko dijiye jisne mahal ke bheetar se uttari dwaar toda! MAHARAJA SOMESHWAR (grave, thundering) Bas, Devika! Is kul-kalank ka paksh lene ki bhool mat karo... anyatha iske saath tumhein bhi is Rajmahal se nishkaasit kar diya jaayega! The guards march Agnivesh down the temple steps and across the citadel toward the ROYAL ARCHIVE TOWER. Devika follows. Ranvijay stays behind, gripping the ANCESTRAL SWORD. INT. ROYAL ARCHIVE TOWER - STAIRWELL - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) Characters: Agnivesh, Devika, Royal Guard 1, Royal Guard 2 ROYAL GUARD 1 and ROYAL GUARD 2 march Agnivesh up the stone stairs, each gripping one of his arms, a spear in the other hand. Devika follows close behind with her brass compass. On the way up, Agnivesh notices three large WARNING CONCHES mounted on brass brackets at the foot of the stairs. They are silent. AGNIVESH (low, steady) Chetaavani-Shankh kyun nahi goonje? Unke naad ke bina shatru dwaar tak kaise pahunch gaya? Devika raises one hand toward the guards. They release his arms and step back a few stairs up, but stay close. Devika sits on a step, takes the folded CELESTIAL WARD MAP from a pouch at her waist and opens it on the step. Agnivesh sits beside her. Devika places her brass compass in the centre of the parchment map. The compass needle spins, then points to the map. Seven gate symbols appear around Suryagarh. Six glow gold. The northern gate is black. A thin violet line runs from the black gate straight to the symbol for Surya Mandir. Devika follows the line with her finger and turns the map toward Agnivesh. DEVIKA (low, urgent) Uttari Raksha-Dwaar ki yeh rekha seedhe Surya Mandir se judi hai... kisi ne mandir ke bheetar se hi Raksha-Kavach ko nishkriya kiya hai! AGNIVESH (grim, realising) Toh shatru ko jal-maarg se laane mein, Rajmahal ke andar ka hi koi vishwasghati mila hua hai. Devika folds the map and holds it out to Agnivesh. DEVIKA (urgent, pleading) Shatru raj-dwaar tak pahunch chuka hai, Agnivesh! Yeh naksha lo aur jitna shighra ho sake, Suryagarh se nikal jao... yahan ka darbar tumhe sirf ashubh balak hi samjhega! Agnivesh refuses to take it. AGNIVESH (quiet, resolute) Main apni janm-bhoomi aur apni praja ko chhodkar kahin nahi jaunga... Agnivesh rises, determined, his eyes on the Rajmahal through the stairwell's open arch. AGNIVESH (firm) Chahe Maharaj mujhe mrityu-dand hi kyun na de dein! Devika rises too, the map and compass in her hands, frustrated, her eyes on Agnivesh. DEVIKA (frustrated, pleading) Zinda rahoge tabhi toh is rajya ki raksha kar paoge, Agnivesh! Darbar ne tumhe nishkaasit kar diya hai... yahan rehna maut ko aamantran dena hai! Agnivesh looks into her eyes and speaks softly. AGNIVESH (soft, steady) Darbar ne nishkaasit kiya hai, Devika... Praja ne nahi! Pitashri ne keval mera naam mitaaya hai, Suryagarh ke prati meri zimmedari nahi! Suddenly, a horn blares from the harbour. EXT. HARBOR BARRACKS GATE - NIGHT (POV FROM ARCHIVE TOWER) Characters: Agnivesh, Devika, Royal Sentries, Shadow Hounds From the tower's open arch, Agnivesh and Devika look down at the shore and the HARBOR BARRACKS GATE, which guards the road up to the Archive Tower. ROYAL SENTRIES in bronze armour defend it with swords, spears and shields. SHADOW HOUNDS race across the shore on all fours. Their black, smoke-like fur trails behind them; violet eyes glow beneath lowered brows. They leap at the sentries, snapping their iron fangs and slashing with their claws. A sentry thrusts his spear at one hound. It dodges, bites the spear shaft and tears it from his hands. Another shadow hound knocks a sentry down and pins his shield with its claws. The sentries fight back, but the shadow hounds force them toward the open gate. INT. ROYAL ARCHIVE TOWER - STAIRWELL - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) Characters: Agnivesh, Devika, Royal Guard 1, Royal Guard 2 Agnivesh turns to ROYAL GUARD 1 and ROYAL GUARD 2. AGNIVESH (urgent, commanding) Suryagarh par mahasankat aa chuka hai! Rakshako, chalo mere saath... Shatru ko rajya ki seema mein pravesh karne se rokna hoga! The two guards lower their heads. ROYAL GUARD 1 (stiff, cold) Maaf kijiye, Rajkumar... Hum sena ke sipahi hain, kisi ashubh kul-kalank ke sevak nahi! Hum keval Maharaj aur Yuvraj Ranvijay ka aadesh maante hain, ek shraapit aur apshaguni balak ka nahi! Agnivesh snatches the spear from ROYAL GUARD 1 and turns to go down. Devika steps in front of him, blocking the stairs. DEVIKA (urgent, voice catching) Ruko, Agnivesh! Apne vaham mein mat jiyo! Akele jaoge toh wah Chhaya-Pashu tumhein zinda chaba jayenge... Aur jinhe bachaane jaa rahe ho, wah tumhari maut par bhi tumhein 'apshagun' hi kahenge! AGNIVESH (low, final) Apshagun hi sahi, Devika... kintu yadi meri bali se is rajya ki raksha hoti hai, toh isse bada aashirvaad mere liye aur kuch nahi hoga! Agnivesh runs down the stairs, the spear in hand, toward the HARBOR BARRACKS GATE. Devika tucks the CELESTIAL WARD MAP back into the pouch at her waist and races down after him. EXT. HARBOR BARRACKS GATE - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) Characters: Agnivesh, Devika, Royal Sentry, Royal Sentries, Shadow Hounds The HARBOR BARRACKS stand beside the seashore. Their gate, the HARBOR BARRACKS GATE, guards the shore road up to the Royal Archive Tower. Outside the barracks gate, three royal sentries fight the shadow hounds. The Shadow Hounds rush at them, snapping their iron fangs and slashing with their claws. One Shadow hound knocks a sentry down and bites his lower leg. It drags him across the stones. He screams and drops his sword. Another shadow hound pins a sentry’s arm with its claws, then bites through his sleeve and pulls him away from his weapon. The third sentry backs toward the gate. He raises his sword, but his hands shake. Agnivesh races down the shore road from the Archive Tower, coming up behind the sentries, spear in hand. Devika follows. A shadow hound turns toward the last standing sentry and leaps at him, jaws wide open. The Royal sentry sees it above him. His sword slips from his hand. He shuts his eyes. Agnivesh throws his spear from behind him. It flies past the Royal sentry and pierces the shadow hound through the chest. The beast’s jaws snap shut just before they reach the sentry. The shadow hound crashes onto the stones at the royal sentry’s feet. Black smoke pours from its mouth. The other shadow hounds stop and stare at the fallen beast. Devika stands by the gate, frozen in shock. The sentry turns to Agnivesh behind him. ROYAL SENTRY (shouting, terrified) Rajkumar Agnivesh! Saare shastra vyarth ho chuke hain... yeh rakt-pyaase pashu kisi bhi shastra se nahi ruk rahe! Agnivesh hauls up the bitten sentry and helps him toward the gate. Devika snaps out of her shock and helps the second wounded sentry through the entrance. AGNIVESH (loud, commanding) Aahat sainikon ko surakshit bheetar le jao aur rajya ke pratyek pravesh-dwaar ko andar se band kar do! Another hound lands on the barracks wall. Its claws split the carved stone and shower the path with fragments. ROYAL SENTRY (panting, panicked) Suryagarh ke mahaveer Yuvraj Ranvijay kahan hain?! Is mahasankat ki ghadi mein humein marne ke liye chhod diya hai?! Agnivesh pulls an IRON SPEAR from a weapon rack on the barracks wall and turns toward the hounds. AGNIVESH (deep, hard) Kisi ka intezaar vyarth hai! Yahi samay hai swayam rakshak banne ka... Apni bhujaon par vishwas karo aur apne logon ko bachao! The sentries carry the wounded through the gate. Devika helps one of them, the CELESTIAL WARD MAP safe in the pouch at her waist. Agnivesh plants himself outside the gate, spear level, between the hounds and the entrance. He paces slowly from one side of the gateway to the other, glaring at the SHADOW HOUNDS. AGNIVESH (cold, clear) Suryagarh ke baahar tumhara raaj hoga... Par jab tak meri saansen chal rahi hain, is dwaar ke bheetar pravesh karne ka vichar bhi— One SHADOW HOUND charges straight at Agnivesh. Two more leap at him at the same time—one from his left and one from his right. Agnivesh thrusts his spear into the first hound’s open mouth. He drives the spear into the ground. The hound dies, its body hanging on the spear. The other two hounds are still in the air. Agnivesh's right sleeve slides back: the SWORD-SHAPED MARK blazes molten gold. He raises his wrist toward them. Golden fire bursts from the mark and turns both hounds to ash before they reach him. Devika and the Royal Sentries stare in shock. AGNIVESH (warning) Bheetar ek kadam bhi badhaya, toh raakh mein badal dunga tum sabko! Seeing their fallen packmate impaled on the spear, the remaining Shadow Hounds hesitate—then retreat into the darkness. Far beyond the hounds, on a black rock at the water's edge, a pair of violet eyes watches. A woman's silhouette (KAALINI) turns away into the mist. HARD CUT

input.title: Andhere Ka Dwaar
input.script_text: EXT. HARBOR BARRACKS GATE - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) Characters: Agnivesh, Devika, Royal Guard 3, Royal Sentries, Shadow Hound AGNIVESH stands outside the open gate, his spear planted in the ground, a dead SHADOW HOUND still impaled on it. The golden glow of the SWORD-SHAPED MARK fades beneath his sleeve. DEVIKA and the wounded ROYAL SENTRIES are just inside the gate. ROYAL GUARD 3 runs down the shore road toward them from the Rajmahal. ROYAL GUARD 3 (urgent, breathless) Rajkumar Agnivesh! Humare saath chhal hua hai! Humein is raaste par uljha kar Kaalini apne chhaya-daanavon ke saath Varuna-Dwaar se Rajmahal mein ghus gayi hai! The dead SHADOW HOUND slides off the spear and thuds onto the stones at Agnivesh's feet, dissolving into black smoke. Agnivesh wrenches the spear free. AGNIVESH (urgent, to Devika) Devika, mere saath chalo. Humein jaldi pahunchna hoga, anyatha bahut bada anarth ho jaayega! Agnivesh runs toward the Rajmahal, Devika close behind him. The ROYAL SENTRIES take their positions at the gate. EXT. SURYAGARH RAJMAHAL - COURTYARD - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) Characters: Agnivesh, Devika, Kaalini, Several Demon Elites The Rajmahal is Suryagarh’s fortified royal palace. High stone walls surround its courtyard. Carved sun emblems mark the walls and gates. Golden ward-lights are fixed above the gates and along the courtyard walls. The courtyard connects to the Surya Mandir, the grand corridor and the throne room. The main gates open on the south side; the steps of the Surya Mandir rise on the east side; on the north side, an arched entrance leads into the Grand Corridor and on to the throne room. KAALINI (30s, pale skin, obsidian hair pinned with serpent ornaments, midnight-blue warrior saree) walks through the open gates. Behind her march the DEMON ELITES: tall warriors in jagged black armour and horned masks, with glowing red eyes, carrying hooked spears. As Kaalini and the Demon Elites pass, the golden ward-lights flicker. Black smoke curls around each light, and they go dark one by one. Agnivesh and Devika rush into the courtyard through an inner passage on the west side and cut across her path at the centre of the courtyard. Agnivesh steps in front of Kaalini and levels his spear. The Demon Elites tighten their grip on their hooked spears, ready to strike. Devika steps up beside him and looks up at the darkening ward-lights. DEVIKA (uneasy, low) Yeh raksha-jyotiyan use rok kyun nahi rahin? Along the walls, the last sun-shaped lights die out. KAALINI (arrogant, venomous) Tumhare Suryagarh ka suraksha-chakra ab mere aage ek bujhi hui raakh hai, Balika. Tumhari prarthana vyarth hai aur tumhara devta vivash. Yahan ab keval mera raaj chalega! Agnivesh looks at the black smoke spreading across the courtyard stones. AGNIVESH (low, to Devika) Raksha-jyotiyan aise hi nahi bujh sakti... Avashya Surya Mandir ke kisi drohi ne bheetar se mantra-bhang kiya hai! Kaalini steps toward Agnivesh and faces him. The Demon Elites stand behind her, spears ready. KAALINI (cold, dismissive) Raasta chhodo, Rajkumar. Ab is mahal par andhkaar ka raaj hoga. AGNIVESH (firm, defiant) Jab tak Agnivesh jeevit hai, singhasan tak pahunchne ka tumhara ye sapna kabhi poora nahi hoga, Kaalini! Behind Kaalini, the Demon Elites point their spears at Agnivesh. Devika stands firm beside him. KAALINI (mocking) Tumhare pita ne tumhara naam mita diya hai, ab tumhara koi adhikaar nahi iss rajya pe. Ab tum keval is mitti par bhatakte hue ek bhikshuk ke samaan ho! Kaalini glances back at her Demon Elites and nods. They turn their hooked spears toward Devika. Devika steps back in fear. Agnivesh steps up beside her and shifts his spear away from Kaalini, pointing it at the Demon Elites. Devika stands firm at his side, unafraid. KAALINI (mocking, to her Demon Elites) Is parajit Rajkumar ka thoda dhyan rakhna, mere veero... Abhi-abhi Suryagarh se nishkaasit hua hai, komal dil hai bechare ka, kahin ro na pade! Kaalini strokes Agnivesh's cheek with mock affection, then walks away toward the Surya Mandir steps on the east side. Her Demon Elites stay, spears levelled at Agnivesh. DEVIKA (urgent) Woh Surya Mandir ki taraf ja rahi hai! Agnivesh replies to Devika in a low voice, his spear still pointed toward the Demon Elites. AGNIVESH (low, urgent) Devika, dev-sevikayon ko surakshit bahar le jao. Main Kaalini ko rokta hoon! Agnivesh pushes back his sleeve. The SWORD-SHAPED MARK on his wrist flares with a blinding golden light. The Demon Elites stagger back, shielding their eyes, and in the confusion Agnivesh and Devika slip away toward the Surya Mandir. INT. SURYA MANDIR - GARBHAGRIHA - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) Characters: Kaalini, Agnivesh, Devika, Temple Priestess Leader, Several Temple Priestesses, Several Demon Elites The SUN ALTAR stands at the centre of the sanctum, beneath the golden SUN MANDALA on the far wall. The main entrance is at the near end, a side arch opens on the left wall, and a small rear doorway is behind the altar. KAALINI strides into the sanctum as several TEMPLE PRIESTESSES in white-and-gold sarees form a circle around the SUN ALTAR. TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER (mid-40s, silver-streaked black hair in a jasmine bun, ivory-and-gold temple-silk drape, crystal mala) stands at the altar, at the head of the circle, and lifts a SACRED SCROLL over it. The priestesses raise brass prayer lamps. Their flames sputter black. The priestesses gasp. The TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER turns to the golden SUN MANDALA above the altar and prays. TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER (shaking, chanting loudly) Surya Dev, is vipatti, iss andhkaar ko Suryagarh se door kijiye! KAALINI (flat, contemptuous) Apne devta ko pukaarna band karo. Tumhari chikh-pukaar is garbhagriha ki deewaron se bahar nahi jayegi... Yahan ab sirf andhere ka raaj hoga, sirf andhere ka... The priestesses shrink back from Kaalini. AGNIVESH enters through a side arch, Devika behind him, and levels his spear at Kaalini's back. AGNIVESH (deep, forceful) Kaalini, inko haani pahunchaane ki sochna bhi mat. Yeh saare nirdosh hain. Kaalini turns slowly toward Agnivesh. The Demon Elites run in through the main entrance and level their spears at him from behind. KAALINI (mocking, measured) Nirdosh? Mat bhoolo, inki wajah se tumko apshagun kaha jaata hai! While Kaalini's eyes are on Agnivesh, Devika quietly leads the temple priestesses toward the rear doorway behind the altar. DEVIKA (low, urgent) Sab log is raaste se niklo, abhi! The TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER runs alongside Devika. At the rear doorway, she turns and calls back to Kaalini. TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER (voice breaking, defiant) Jab tak Surya vansh ki jyoti jal rahi hai, tumhara andhkaar nahi jeetega! Kaalini smiles. She draws her SERPENT DAGGER and hurls it. It slashes across the Priestess Leader's throat. A prayer lamp falls from her hand and rolls across the marble. The TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER collapses in the doorway. Agnivesh rushes to the rear doorway and sinks to one knee beside the fallen Priestess Leader. AGNIVESH (voice deep, restrained) Tumne ek rakshak ko nahi maara, Kaalini. Tumne Suryagarh ke pavitra man-mastisk mein vaar kiya hai. KAALINI (quiet, cruel) Abhi toh shuruaat hai, Rajkumar... Aaj tumhare devta, tumhara astitva, aur yeh poora Suryagarh mere andhere mein vileen ho jayega! Kaalini's dagger slithers back across the marble like a serpent, rises into the air, and she catches it. She licks the blood off its blade and turns to her Demon Elites. KAALINI (sharp, commanding) Mere veero, iss ashubh rajkumar ko chhodo aur aage badho! The Demon Elites turn and rush out of the temple toward the Grand Corridor. Kaalini follows them. Agnivesh stays on his knees beside the fallen Priestess Leader. Devika leads the surviving priestesses to safety. INT. RAJMAHAL - GRAND CORRIDOR - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) Characters: Agnivesh, Devika, Kaalini, Rajguru Badrinath, Several Demon Elites, Several Shadow Warriors, Several Royal Guards The long corridor runs from the courtyard arch to the throne-room doors at the far end, lined with sun-carved pillars, with royal guards posted before the doors. RAJGURU BADRINATH (bald, flame-and-lotus scalp tattoo, white beard, saffron robes) stands beside a sun-carved pillar near the corridor's entrance as Kaalini enters. RAJGURU BADRINATH lowers his eyes and steps aside as Kaalini and her Demon Elites pass. Agnivesh runs in. He spots RAJGURU BADRINATH near the pillar and stops short. AGNIVESH (strained, respectful) Rajguru Badrinath, aap yahan khade kyun hain? Use rokiye! Badrinath presses his prayer beads between both palms. He faces Agnivesh without lifting his head. RAJGURU BADRINATH (low, trembling) Maine hi Kaalini ka raasta khola tha. Agar main aisa nahi karta toh Timiraksha mere poore parivaar ko maar deta. Agnivesh takes one hard step toward him. AGNIVESH (deep, wounded) Aapne is rajya ki raksha ki kasam khaayi thi. Aur aapne apne parivaar ko bachane ke liye... Suryagarh ke hazaaron parivaaron ki jaan khatre mein daal di. Rajguru Badrinath lowers his head, unable to answer. Kaalini reaches the middle of the corridor. Her Demon Elites rush ahead, forcing the royal guards aside. Agnivesh charges after her, spear raised. Several Demon Elites turn and lock their hooked spears together, blocking his way. Agnivesh strikes the spear-wall, trying to break through, but they hold firm. Devika rushes into the corridor after guiding the surviving priestesses to safety. Kaalini kneels and cuts a mark into the marble with her serpent dagger. A black, blood-like seal spreads across the floor. KAALINI (low, chanting) Rakta se bandho. Surya ki shakti bujha do. DEVIKA (shouting to Agnivesh) Agnivesh! Uska rakta-bandhan bhang karo! Yeh singhasan ki shakti kheench rahi hai! Agnivesh pushes against the Demon Elites’ spears. AGNIVESH (straining, furious) Kaalini! Suryagarh ki mitti par tera yeh andhera kabhi nahi tikne doonga main! Kaalini stands and lifts her dagger for all to see. KAALINI (triumphant) Tumhare rajya ka ant ho chuka hai, rajya se nikaale hue Rajkumar! Timiraksha apna raj-bali lene aa raha hai! Black smoke spreads beneath the throne room doors. The guards at the far end step back in fear. AGNIVESH (desperate, fierce) Maharaj ko haani pahunchaane ki sochna bhi mat... Mere pita ko kuch hua toh tumhare poore andhere ke saamrajya ko jala ke raakh kar dunga! Kaalini turns toward the throne room and raises her hand. KAALINI (calling out, triumphant) Maharaj Someshwar… Timiraksha aapke liye aa raha hai! The throne-room doors BLAST off their hinges and crash across the corridor. The Demon Elites are thrown to the floor. Black smoke pours through the broken doorway. Tall, lean Shadow Warriors emerge from it, their bodies covered in shifting black armour. Violet eyes glow through their masks, and curved blades extend from their hands. The Demon Elites rise and gather behind Kaalini. Black smoke wraps around them. Their heavy armour changes shape, turning dark and smoke-like as they join the Shadow Warriors’ ranks. The royal guards step back in fear. One drops his spear. Devika moves behind a stone pillar. Agnivesh sees Kaalini near the open throne-room doorway. He breaks free of the spear-wall and runs toward her as the Shadow Warriors close in behind her. HARD CUT

output.manual_text:
Director Production Plan: Episode 5 — "Andhere Ka Dwaar"

*v2, 24 Oct 2026. Built from the approved storyboard `ep5_shotlist_v2.json` (Nin's round-1 notes + tightened micro-drama pacing): 76 shots · 304s (5m04s) · 13 video tracks · Seedance 2.5, 480p, native 9:16. Replaces v1 (71 shots / 403s / 18 tracks), backed up in `ep5/_bak_pre_tracks_v2/`. Shot numbers below are v2 numbers.*

① Theme & Narrative Core
The episode is the night the walls fail from the inside. Kaalini doesn't break Suryagarh's protection, she walks through it: the ward-lights die in purple smoke as she passes, the prayer lamps gutter out, and the throne-room doors blast open for her. Agnivesh, disowned and named ill-omened, is the only one who stands in her way, and in each scene he's held back a step too late: by her mockery in the courtyard, by the death of the Priestess Leader in the sanctum, by the spear-wall in the corridor. The core is a stripped prince protecting the people who rejected him. Kaalini's taunts land because they're true (his father erased his name), and he answers with action, not speeches.

**Natural Acting Direction**

Agnivesh: still and contained. His power shows in what he holds back: he doesn't flinch when Kaalini strokes his cheek (28), and his line over the Priestess Leader is quiet (51). He lets go only on the last threat about his father (69).
Kaalini: never shouts. Her cruelty is in her ease: she walks, smiles and almost whispers. Her only raised moments are the triumphant lines in the corridor (67, 70), and even those stay under a scream.
Devika: real fear when the spears swing to her (25), then she stands firm beside him. In the sanctum she's quick and quiet, an organiser rather than a fighter (44).
Temple Priestess Leader: shaking but loud in prayer (37); her last line breaks but doesn't collapse (45).
Royal Guard 3: a messenger out of breath, not a soldier giving a speech (3).
Badrinath: a silent figure by a pillar who doesn't react (56). No look to camera, no guilty acting.
Dialogue: all 26 script lines (30 Devanagari segments) verbatim, at or under 2.8 words per second.
② Visual Style & Framing Tone (Native 9:16 Vertical)
Live-action photorealistic historical Indian epic at night, period practical light only: torches, lamps, ward-lights, the oculus moonbeam and the gold flare of the mark. The grade moves from cold sea-blue (harbour) through gold dying to purple-smoked blue-black (courtyard) and amber and copper going dark (sanctum) to torch pools against moonlight, with violet creeping in (corridor). The cracked dome stays a faint shimmer in every exterior sky.

**Smoke and light rules (Nin's style, applied to every prompt)**

Shadow Hounds trail purple smoke, leak it when hurt, and dissolve into it when killed (the impaled hound dissolves at 5).
Demon smoke is purple, or purple-and-black: Kaalini's entrances (8, 35), the dying ward-lights (10, 15), the smoke across the stones (18), the smoke under the throne-room doors and out of the broken doorway (68, 71–74).
Non-magical props give black smoke only: the prayer lamps gutter out in thin black smoke (36).
The blood seal is black with a blood-red glow pulsing inside it (63).
The courtyard derivative is "Ward-Lights Dark (Purple Smoke)".
**Cinematography Direction**

Native 9:16: at most two people side by side; groups (elites, priestesses, guards) are always staged in depth, never in a line across the frame. Every shot line in the prompts carries a "Sides:" note for the top, middle and bottom thirds.
Faces in the centre third. Spears and dagger lines run vertically or diagonally into depth.
No slow sideways pans. Drama moves are slow push-ins, drifts, arcs, cranes and track-backs.
FAST beats, Marvel-style (15: 11, 25, 26, 32, 40, 42, 44, 46, 47, 51, 53, 58, 61, 67, 71): speed ramps, snap push-ins, fast track-outs and bullet time, exactly as written. The big ones: the leap with the extreme slow-motion sweep past the elites' faces (26), the mark flare (32), the bullet-time flight of the Serpent Dagger with the camera racing backward ahead of its tip (47), the slow-motion spark beat on the spear-wall (61), and the doors blast (71).
Static holds (9: 10, 14, 21, 45, 52, 60, 64, 68, 75) for the ward-light dying, Devika's question, his answer to Kaalini, the Leader's defiance, Kaalini's quiet threat, the spear-wall locking, the chant, the smoke under the doors and the guards' fear.
Screen line: Kaalini and her forces screen-left facing right; Agnivesh and Devika screen-right facing left, the same as Ep 4. The sanctum reverse and the corridor reverse are chosen so this holds.
Lenses: 24–32mm wides with deep focus, 40–50mm mediums, 75–85mm close-ups, 100mm for the inserts (the elite's grip, the smoke at his boots, the wrist, the dagger, the seal, the mask).

**Key Visual Turning Points**

Shot 5: the dead hound dissolves into purple smoke, its violet eyes the last to fade.

**Scene 2 — Rajmahal Courtyard (shots 8–33 / 105s)**

Emotional Target: Dread, then defiance under humiliation.
Atmosphere: Gold ward-light choking to purple smoke; cold moonlight; smoke low on the stones.
Camera Intent: Kaalini's intro close-up as she steps out of the smoke (8), a high wide of the elites marching in (9), the first ward-light dying (10). Agnivesh's run in (11, FAST) and the elite's grip insert (12). The standoff plays in singles and two-shots with the elites always in depth behind Kaalini; her taunts are held on arcs and push-ins; the extreme wide that cranes down to a medium for "Raasta chhodo" (20). The spears swing to Devika (25) and his leap (26). Kaalini leaves for the temple (29, East View to the Surya Mandir Steps); the mark flares (32) and they slip away (33).
Spatial Staging: Kaalini screen-left with the elites stacked behind her; Agnivesh and Devika screen-right. The temple steps lie east. The courtyard is "Suryagarh Rajdurg Gate" until the last lights die (8–14), then "Ward-Lights Dark (Purple Smoke)" (15–33, except 29).
**Scene 3 — Surya Mandir Garbhagriha (Inner Sanctum) (shots 34–55 / 87s)**

Emotional Target: Sacred calm broken, then grief.
Atmosphere: Amber lamps guttering out in thin black smoke, incense, the oculus moonbeam, the copper glow of the mandala.
Camera Intent: From the entrance (Inner Sanctum) for the ritual; Kaalini enters through purple smoke on the reverse (35, Reverse From the Altar Toward the Entrance); the reverse for Agnivesh's entrance and the trap (40–43); the rear doorway (Rear Doorway Behind the Altar) for the escape and the death (44–45, 48–51). The killing is restrained: a thin dark line, no spray, and the camera follows her down and stays on the rolling lamp.
Spatial Staging: Priestesses in a ring in depth around the altar; Kaalini mid-sanctum; Agnivesh in the side arch, screen-right; the elites in the main entrance behind him.
**Scene 4 — Grand Corridor (shots 56–76 / 81s)**

Emotional Target: Frustration and urgency, then horror.
Atmosphere: Torch pools and moonlight; the black seal with its blood-red glow; purple-and-black smoke from the throne room.
Camera Intent: The reverse toward the arch (Reverse Toward the Courtyard Arch) for every entrance (Kaalini past Badrinath 56, Agnivesh 58, Devika 62, 65), and the base (Grand Corridor) toward the doors for the striding reveal (57), the spear-wall (60–61), the seal (63–64) and the ritual. The blast (71) is the only shake; then the mask surfacing (72), the warriors stepping out (73) and the armour change (74, Shadow-Fused Armour) on the broken doorway (Throne-Room Doors Blasted Open). Badrinath is visible only in shot 56, as background: no reaction shot and no confrontation.
Spatial Staging: Kaalini mid-corridor; the spear-wall between her and Agnivesh; Royal Guard 2 and the palace guards by the doors in depth; Devika at the arch, then behind a pillar (75).
**Lighting Direction:** only practical, motivated sources. Harbour: moon and torches. Courtyard: gold ward-lights that die in thin purple smoke (they never relight), then moonlight. Sanctum: brass lamp towers and the oculus; the lamps gutter out in thin black smoke. Corridor: torch pools and high windows; the seal's blood-red glow (63–64); from 68, violet light and purple-and-black smoke from under the doors, then from the broken doorway. The bright exception is the mark's gold flare (32–33).

⑤ Sound Direction
Harbour: waves, torches, ragged breath; a long rising hiss as the hound dissolves. Courtyard: marching iron, a hiss as each ward-light dies, then near-silence for the taunts. Sanctum: a chanting hum that chokes off when the lamps die; a slowed, stretched hiss of steel and a heartbeat in the bullet time; the rolling lamp is the loudest sound in the scene. Corridor: echoing footsteps, iron on iron, the seal's wet spreading hiss under Kaalini's chant, the boom of the doors, blades sliding out of forearms.
Dialogue is Hindi in Devanagari, lip-synced, with only the named speaker talking. No music cue is written into the prompts; the score is the editor's.
⑥ Transitions & Visual Continuity
In from Ep 4: the mark glowing, the hound impaled on the planted spear and trailing purple smoke, Devika and the sentries in the gateway (track 1 start state).
Hard cuts only. Scene changes go harbour → courtyard (lights burning) → sanctum → corridor; each track's start state is the previous track's end.

input.script_text: EXT. HARBOR BARRACKS GATE - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) Characters: Agnivesh, Devika, Royal Guard 3, Royal Sentries, Shadow Hound AGNIVESH stands outside the open gate, his spear planted in the ground, a dead SHADOW HOUND still impaled on it. The golden glow of the SWORD-SHAPED MARK fades beneath his sleeve. DEVIKA and the wounded ROYAL SENTRIES are just inside the gate. ROYAL GUARD 3 runs down the shore road toward them from the Rajmahal. ROYAL GUARD 3 (urgent, breathless) Rajkumar Agnivesh! Humare saath chhal hua hai! Humein is raaste par uljha kar Kaalini apne chhaya-daanavon ke saath Varuna-Dwaar se Rajmahal mein ghus gayi hai! The dead SHADOW HOUND slides off the spear and thuds onto the stones at Agnivesh's feet, dissolving into black smoke. Agnivesh wrenches the spear free. AGNIVESH (urgent, to Devika) Devika, mere saath chalo. Humein jaldi pahunchna hoga, anyatha bahut bada anarth ho jaayega! Agnivesh runs toward the Rajmahal, Devika close behind him. The ROYAL SENTRIES take their positions at the gate. EXT. SURYAGARH RAJMAHAL - COURTYARD - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) Characters: Agnivesh, Devika, Kaalini, Several Demon Elites The Rajmahal is Suryagarh’s fortified royal palace. High stone walls surround its courtyard. Carved sun emblems mark the walls and gates. Golden ward-lights are fixed above the gates and along the courtyard walls. The courtyard connects to the Surya Mandir, the grand corridor and the throne room. The main gates open on the south side; the steps of the Surya Mandir rise on the east side; on the north side, an arched entrance leads into the Grand Corridor and on to the throne room. KAALINI (30s, pale skin, obsidian hair pinned with serpent ornaments, midnight-blue warrior saree) walks through the open gates. Behind her march the DEMON ELITES: tall warriors in jagged black armour and horned masks, with glowing red eyes, carrying hooked spears. As Kaalini and the Demon Elites pass, the golden ward-lights flicker. Black smoke curls around each light, and they go dark one by one. Agnivesh and Devika rush into the courtyard through an inner passage on the west side and cut across her path at the centre of the courtyard. Agnivesh steps in front of Kaalini and levels his spear. The Demon Elites tighten their grip on their hooked spears, ready to strike. Devika steps up beside him and looks up at the darkening ward-lights. DEVIKA (uneasy, low) Yeh raksha-jyotiyan use rok kyun nahi rahin? Along the walls, the last sun-shaped lights die out. KAALINI (arrogant, venomous) Tumhare Suryagarh ka suraksha-chakra ab mere aage ek bujhi hui raakh hai, Balika. Tumhari prarthana vyarth hai aur tumhara devta vivash. Yahan ab keval mera raaj chalega! Agnivesh looks at the black smoke spreading across the courtyard stones. AGNIVESH (low, to Devika) Raksha-jyotiyan aise hi nahi bujh sakti... Avashya Surya Mandir ke kisi drohi ne bheetar se mantra-bhang kiya hai! Kaalini steps toward Agnivesh and faces him. The Demon Elites stand behind her, spears ready. KAALINI (cold, dismissive) Raasta chhodo, Rajkumar. Ab is mahal par andhkaar ka raaj hoga. AGNIVESH (firm, defiant) Jab tak Agnivesh jeevit hai, singhasan tak pahunchne ka tumhara ye sapna kabhi poora nahi hoga, Kaalini! Behind Kaalini, the Demon Elites point their spears at Agnivesh. Devika stands firm beside him. KAALINI (mocking) Tumhare pita ne tumhara naam mita diya hai, ab tumhara koi adhikaar nahi iss rajya pe. Ab tum keval is mitti par bhatakte hue ek bhikshuk ke samaan ho! Kaalini glances back at her Demon Elites and nods. They turn their hooked spears toward Devika. Devika steps back in fear. Agnivesh steps up beside her and shifts his spear away from Kaalini, pointing it at the Demon Elites. Devika stands firm at his side, unafraid. KAALINI (mocking, to her Demon Elites) Is parajit Rajkumar ka thoda dhyan rakhna, mere veero... Abhi-abhi Suryagarh se nishkaasit hua hai, komal dil hai bechare ka, kahin ro na pade! Kaalini strokes Agnivesh's cheek with mock affection, then walks away toward the Surya Mandir steps on the east side. Her Demon Elites stay, spears levelled at Agnivesh. DEVIKA (urgent) Woh Surya Mandir ki taraf ja rahi hai! Agnivesh replies to Devika in a low voice, his spear still pointed toward the Demon Elites. AGNIVESH (low, urgent) Devika, dev-sevikayon ko surakshit bahar le jao. Main Kaalini ko rokta hoon! Agnivesh pushes back his sleeve. The SWORD-SHAPED MARK on his wrist flares with a blinding golden light. The Demon Elites stagger back, shielding their eyes, and in the confusion Agnivesh and Devika slip away toward the Surya Mandir. INT. SURYA MANDIR - GARBHAGRIHA - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) Characters: Kaalini, Agnivesh, Devika, Temple Priestess Leader, Several Temple Priestesses, Several Demon Elites The SUN ALTAR stands at the centre of the sanctum, beneath the golden SUN MANDALA on the far wall. The main entrance is at the near end, a side arch opens on the left wall, and a small rear doorway is behind the altar. KAALINI strides into the sanctum as several TEMPLE PRIESTESSES in white-and-gold sarees form a circle around the SUN ALTAR. TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER (mid-40s, silver-streaked black hair in a jasmine bun, ivory-and-gold temple-silk drape, crystal mala) stands at the altar, at the head of the circle, and lifts a SACRED SCROLL over it. The priestesses raise brass prayer lamps. Their flames sputter black. The priestesses gasp. The TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER turns to the golden SUN MANDALA above the altar and prays. TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER (shaking, chanting loudly) Surya Dev, is vipatti, iss andhkaar ko Suryagarh se door kijiye! KAALINI (flat, contemptuous) Apne devta ko pukaarna band karo. Tumhari chikh-pukaar is garbhagriha ki deewaron se bahar nahi jayegi... Yahan ab sirf andhere ka raaj hoga, sirf andhere ka... The priestesses shrink back from Kaalini. AGNIVESH enters through a side arch, Devika behind him, and levels his spear at Kaalini's back. AGNIVESH (deep, forceful) Kaalini, inko haani pahunchaane ki sochna bhi mat. Yeh saare nirdosh hain. Kaalini turns slowly toward Agnivesh. The Demon Elites run in through the main entrance and level their spears at him from behind. KAALINI (mocking, measured) Nirdosh? Mat bhoolo, inki wajah se tumko apshagun kaha jaata hai! While Kaalini's eyes are on Agnivesh, Devika quietly leads the temple priestesses toward the rear doorway behind the altar. DEVIKA (low, urgent) Sab log is raaste se niklo, abhi! The TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER runs alongside Devika. At the rear doorway, she turns and calls back to Kaalini. TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER (voice breaking, defiant) Jab tak Surya vansh ki jyoti jal rahi hai, tumhara andhkaar nahi jeetega! Kaalini smiles. She draws her SERPENT DAGGER and hurls it. It slashes across the Priestess Leader's throat. A prayer lamp falls from her hand and rolls across the marble. The TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER collapses in the doorway. Agnivesh rushes to the rear doorway and sinks to one knee beside the fallen Priestess Leader. AGNIVESH (voice deep, restrained) Tumne ek rakshak ko nahi maara, Kaalini. Tumne Suryagarh ke pavitra man-mastisk mein vaar kiya hai. KAALINI (quiet, cruel) Abhi toh shuruaat hai, Rajkumar... Aaj tumhare devta, tumhara astitva, aur yeh poora Suryagarh mere andhere mein vileen ho jayega! Kaalini's dagger slithers back across the marble like a serpent, rises into the air, and she catches it. She licks the blood off its blade and turns to her Demon Elites. KAALINI (sharp, commanding) Mere veero, iss ashubh rajkumar ko chhodo aur aage badho! The Demon Elites turn and rush out of the temple toward the Grand Corridor. Kaalini follows them. Agnivesh stays on his knees beside the fallen Priestess Leader. Devika leads the surviving priestesses to safety. INT. RAJMAHAL - GRAND CORRIDOR - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) Characters: Agnivesh, Devika, Kaalini, Rajguru Badrinath, Several Demon Elites, Several Shadow Warriors, Several Royal Guards The long corridor runs from the courtyard arch to the throne-room doors at the far end, lined with sun-carved pillars, with royal guards posted before the doors. RAJGURU BADRINATH (bald, flame-and-lotus scalp tattoo, white beard, saffron robes) stands beside a sun-carved pillar near the corridor's entrance as Kaalini enters. RAJGURU BADRINATH lowers his eyes and steps aside as Kaalini and her Demon Elites pass. Agnivesh runs in. He spots RAJGURU BADRINATH near the pillar and stops short. AGNIVESH (strained, respectful) Rajguru Badrinath, aap yahan khade kyun hain? Use rokiye! Badrinath presses his prayer beads between both palms. He faces Agnivesh without lifting his head. RAJGURU BADRINATH (low, trembling) Maine hi Kaalini ka raasta khola tha. Agar main aisa nahi karta toh Timiraksha mere poore parivaar ko maar deta. Agnivesh takes one hard step toward him. AGNIVESH (deep, wounded) Aapne is rajya ki raksha ki kasam khaayi thi. Aur aapne apne parivaar ko bachane ke liye... Suryagarh ke hazaaron parivaaron ki jaan khatre mein daal di. Rajguru Badrinath lowers his head, unable to answer. Kaalini reaches the middle of the corridor. Her Demon Elites rush ahead, forcing the royal guards aside. Agnivesh charges after her, spear raised. Several Demon Elites turn and lock their hooked spears together, blocking his way. Agnivesh strikes the spear-wall, trying to break through, but they hold firm. Devika rushes into the corridor after guiding the surviving priestesses to safety. Kaalini kneels and cuts a mark into the marble with her serpent dagger. A black, blood-like seal spreads across the floor. KAALINI (low, chanting) Rakta se bandho. Surya ki shakti bujha do. DEVIKA (shouting to Agnivesh) Agnivesh! Uska rakta-bandhan bhang karo! Yeh singhasan ki shakti kheench rahi hai! Agnivesh pushes against the Demon Elites’ spears. AGNIVESH (straining, furious) Kaalini! Suryagarh ki mitti par tera yeh andhera kabhi nahi tikne doonga main! Kaalini stands and lifts her dagger for all to see. KAALINI (triumphant) Tumhare rajya ka ant ho chuka hai, rajya se nikaale hue Rajkumar! Timiraksha apna raj-bali lene aa raha hai! Black smoke spreads beneath the throne room doors. The guards at the far end step back in fear. AGNIVESH (desperate, fierce) Maharaj ko haani pahunchaane ki sochna bhi mat... Mere pita ko kuch hua toh tumhare poore andhere ke saamrajya ko jala ke raakh kar dunga! Kaalini turns toward the throne room and raises her hand. KAALINI (calling out, triumphant) Maharaj Someshwar… Timiraksha aapke liye aa raha hai! The throne-room doors BLAST off their hinges and crash across the corridor. The Demon Elites are thrown to the floor. Black smoke pours through the broken doorway. Tall, lean Shadow Warriors emerge from it, their bodies covered in shifting black armour. Violet eyes glow through their masks, and curved blades extend from their hands. The Demon Elites rise and gather behind Kaalini. Black smoke wraps around them. Their heavy armour changes shape, turning dark and smoke-like as they join the Shadow Warriors’ ranks. The royal guards step back in fear. One drops his spear. Devika moves behind a stone pillar. Agnivesh sees Kaalini near the open throne-room doorway. He breaks free of the spear-wall and runs toward her as the Shadow Warriors close in behind her. HARD CUT

output.section_text:
① Theme & Narrative Core
The episode is the night the walls fail from the inside. Kaalini doesn't break Suryagarh's protection, she walks through it: the ward-lights die in purple smoke as she passes, the prayer lamps gutter out, and the throne-room doors blast open for her. Agnivesh, disowned and named ill-omened, is the only one who stands in her way, and in each scene he's held back a step too late: by her mockery in the courtyard, by the death of the Priestess Leader in the sanctum, by the spear-wall in the corridor. The core is a stripped prince protecting the people who rejected him. Kaalini's taunts land because they're true (his father erased his name), and he answers with action, not speeches.

**Natural Acting Direction**

Agnivesh: still and contained. His power shows in what he holds back: he doesn't flinch when Kaalini strokes his cheek (28), and his line over the Priestess Leader is quiet (51). He lets go only on the last threat about his father (69).
Kaalini: never shouts. Her cruelty is in her ease: she walks, smiles and almost whispers. Her only raised moments are the triumphant lines in the corridor (67, 70), and even those stay under a scream.

The ROYAL SENTRIES take their positions at the gate. EXT. SURYAGARH RAJMAHAL - COURTYARD - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) Characters: Agnivesh, Devika, Kaalini, Several Demon Elites The Rajmahal is Suryagarh’s fortified royal palace. High stone walls surround its courtyard. Carved sun emblems mark the walls and gates. Golden ward-lights are fixed above the gates and along the courtyard walls. The courtyard connects to the Surya Mandir, the grand corridor and the throne room. Agnivesh and Devika rush into the courtyard through an inner passage on the west side and cut across her path at the centre of the courtyard. Agnivesh steps in front of Kaalini and levels his spear. The Demon Elites tighten their grip on their hooked spears, ready to strike. Devika steps up beside him and looks up at the darkening ward-lights. DEVIKA (uneasy, low) Yeh raksha-jyotiyan use rok kyun nahi rahin? Along the walls, the last sun-shaped lights die out. KAALINI (arrogant, venomous) Tumhare Suryagarh ka suraksha-chakra ab mere aage ek bujhi hui raakh hai, Balika. Tumhari prarthana vyarth hai aur tumhara devta vivash. Yahan ab keval mera raaj chalega! Avashya Surya Mandir ke kisi drohi ne bheetar se mantra-bhang kiya hai! Kaalini steps toward Agnivesh and faces him. The Demon Elites stand behind her, spears ready. KAALINI (cold, dismissive) Raasta chhodo, Rajkumar. Ab is mahal par andhkaar ka raaj hoga. Ab tum keval is mitti par bhatakte hue ek bhikshuk ke samaan ho! Kaalini glances back at her Demon Elites and nods. They turn their hooked spears toward Devika. Devika steps back in fear. Agnivesh steps up beside her and shifts his spear away from Kaalini, pointing it at the Demon Elites. Devika stands firm at his side, unafraid. KAALINI (mocking, to her Demon Elites) Is parajit Rajkumar ka thoda dhyan rakhna, mere veero... Abhi-abhi Suryagarh se nishkaasit hua hai, komal dil hai bechare ka, kahin ro na pade! Kaalini strokes Agnivesh's cheek with mock affection, then walks away toward the Surya Mandir steps on the east side. Her Demon Elites stay, spears levelled at Agnivesh. DEVIKA (urgent) Woh Surya Mandir ki taraf ja rahi hai! Agnivesh replies to Devika in a low voice, his spear still pointed toward the Demon Elites. AGNIVESH (low, urgent) Devika, dev-sevikayon ko surakshit bahar le jao. Main Kaalini ko rokta hoon! Agnivesh pushes back his sleeve. The SWORD-SHAPED MARK on his wrist flares with a blinding golden light. The Demon Elites stagger back, shielding their eyes, and in the confusion Agnivesh and Devika slip away toward the Surya Mandir. INT.
