The main entrance is at the near end, a side arch opens on the left wall, and a small rear doorway is behind the altar. KAALINI strides into the sanctum as several TEMPLE PRIESTESSES in white-and-gold sarees form a circle around the SUN ALTAR. TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER (mid-40s, silver-streaked black hair in a jasmine bun, ivory-and-gold temple-silk drape, crystal mala) stands at the altar, at the head of the circle, and lifts a SACRED SCROLL over it. The priestesses raise brass prayer lamps. Their flames sputter black. The priestesses gasp. The TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER turns to the golden SUN MANDALA above the altar and prays. TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER (shaking, chanting loudly) Surya Dev, is vipatti, iss andhkaar ko Suryagarh se door kijiye! KAALINI (flat, contemptuous) Apne devta ko pukaarna band karo. Tumhari chikh-pukaar is garbhagriha ki deewaron se bahar nahi jayegi... Yahan ab sirf andhere ka raaj hoga, sirf andhere ka... The priestesses shrink back from Kaalini. AGNIVESH enters through a side arch, Devika behind him, and levels his spear at Kaalini's back. AGNIVESH (deep, forceful) Kaalini, inko haani pahunchaane ki sochna bhi mat. Yeh saare nirdosh hain. Kaalini turns slowly toward Agnivesh. The Demon Elites run in through the main entrance and level their spears at him from behind. KAALINI (mocking, measured) Nirdosh? Mat bhoolo, inki wajah se tumko apshagun kaha jaata hai! While Kaalini's eyes are on Agnivesh, Devika quietly leads the temple priestesses toward the rear doorway behind the altar. DEVIKA (low, urgent) Sab log is raaste se niklo, abhi! The TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER runs alongside Devika. At the rear doorway, she turns and calls back to Kaalini. TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER (voice breaking, defiant) Jab tak Surya vansh ki jyoti jal rahi hai, tumhara andhkaar nahi jeetega! Kaalini smiles. She draws her SERPENT DAGGER and hurls it. It slashes across the Priestess Leader's throat. A prayer lamp falls from her hand and rolls across the marble. The TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER collapses in the doorway. Agnivesh rushes to the rear doorway and sinks to one knee beside the fallen Priestess Leader. AGNIVESH (voice deep, restrained) Tumne ek rakshak ko nahi maara, Kaalini. Tumne Suryagarh ke pavitra man-mastisk mein vaar kiya hai. KAALINI (quiet, cruel) Abhi toh shuruaat hai, Rajkumar... Aaj tumhare devta, tumhara astitva, aur yeh poora Suryagarh mere andhere mein vileen ho jayega! Kaalini's dagger slithers back across the marble like a serpent, rises into the air, and she catches it. She licks the blood off its blade and turns to her Demon Elites. KAALINI (sharp, commanding) Mere veero, iss ashubh rajkumar ko chhodo aur aage badho! The Demon Elites turn and rush out of the temple toward the Grand Corridor. Kaalini follows them. Agnivesh stays on his knees beside the fallen Priestess Leader. Devika leads the surviving priestesses to safety. INT. RAJMAHAL - GRAND CORRIDOR - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) Characters: Agnivesh, Devika, Kaalini, Rajguru Badrinath, Several Demon Elites, Several Shadow Warriors, Several Royal Guards The long corridor runs from the courtyard arch to the throne-room doors at the far end, lined with sun-carved pillars, with royal guards posted before the doors. RAJGURU BADRINATH (bald, flame-and-lotus scalp tattoo, white beard, saffron robes) stands beside a sun-carved pillar near the corridor's entrance as Kaalini enters. RAJGURU BADRINATH lowers his eyes and steps aside as Kaalini and her Demon Elites pass. Agnivesh runs in. He spots RAJGURU BADRINATH near the pillar and stops short. AGNIVESH (strained, respectful) Rajguru Badrinath, aap yahan khade kyun hain? Use rokiye! Badrinath presses his prayer beads between both palms. He faces Agnivesh without lifting his head. RAJGURU BADRINATH (low, trembling) Maine hi Kaalini ka raasta khola tha. Agar main aisa nahi karta toh Timiraksha mere poore parivaar ko maar deta. Agnivesh takes one hard step toward him. AGNIVESH (deep, wounded) Aapne is rajya ki raksha ki kasam khaayi thi. Aur aapne apne parivaar ko bachane ke liye... Suryagarh ke hazaaron parivaaron ki jaan khatre mein daal di. Rajguru Badrinath lowers his head, unable to answer. Kaalini reaches the middle of the corridor. Her Demon Elites rush ahead, forcing the royal guards aside. Agnivesh charges after her, spear raised. Several Demon Elites turn and lock their hooked spears together, blocking his way. Agnivesh strikes the spear-wall, trying to break through, but they hold firm. Devika rushes into the corridor after guiding the surviving priestesses to safety. Kaalini kneels and cuts a mark into the marble with her serpent dagger. A black, blood-like seal spreads across the floor. KAALINI (low, chanting) Rakta se bandho. Surya ki shakti bujha do. DEVIKA (shouting to Agnivesh) Agnivesh! Uska rakta-bandhan bhang karo! Yeh singhasan ki shakti kheench rahi hai! Agnivesh pushes against the Demon Elites’ spears. AGNIVESH (straining, furious) Kaalini! Suryagarh ki mitti par tera yeh andhera kabhi nahi tikne doonga main! Kaalini stands and lifts her dagger for all to see. KAALINI (triumphant) Tumhare rajya ka ant ho chuka hai, rajya se nikaale hue Rajkumar! Timiraksha apna raj-bali lene aa raha hai! Black smoke spreads beneath the throne room doors. The guards at the far end step back in fear. AGNIVESH (desperate, fierce) Maharaj ko haani pahunchaane ki sochna bhi mat... Mere pita ko kuch hua toh tumhare poore andhere ke saamrajya ko jala ke raakh kar dunga! Kaalini turns toward the throne room and raises her hand. KAALINI (calling out, triumphant) Maharaj Someshwar… Timiraksha aapke liye aa raha hai! The throne-room doors BLAST off their hinges and crash across the corridor. The Demon Elites are thrown to the floor. Black smoke pours through the broken doorway. Tall, lean Shadow Warriors emerge from it, their bodies covered in shifting black armour. Violet eyes glow through their masks, and curved blades extend from their hands. The Demon Elites rise and gather behind Kaalini. Black smoke wraps around them. Their heavy armour changes shape, turning dark and smoke-like as they join the Shadow Warriors’ ranks. The royal guards step back in fear. One drops his spear. Devika moves behind a stone pillar. Agnivesh sees Kaalini near the open throne-room doorway. He breaks free of the spear-wall and runs toward her as the Shadow Warriors close in behind her. HARD CUT

output.section_text:
② Visual Style & Framing Tone (Native 9:16 Vertical)
Live-action photorealistic historical Indian epic at night, period practical light only: torches, lamps, ward-lights, the oculus moonbeam and the gold flare of the mark. The grade moves from cold sea-blue (harbour) through gold dying to purple-smoked blue-black (courtyard) and amber and copper going dark (sanctum) to torch pools against moonlight, with violet creeping in (corridor). The cracked dome stays a faint shimmer in every exterior sky.

**Smoke and light rules (Nin's style, applied to every prompt)**

Shadow Hounds trail purple smoke, leak it when hurt, and dissolve into it when killed (the impaled hound dissolves at 5).
Demon smoke is purple, or purple-and-black: Kaalini's entrances (8, 35), the dying ward-lights (10, 15), the smoke across the stones (18), the smoke under the throne-room doors and out of the broken doorway (68, 71–74).
Non-magical props give black smoke only: the prayer lamps gutter out in thin black smoke (36).
The blood seal is black with a blood-red glow pulsing inside it (63).
The courtyard derivative is "Ward-Lights Dark (Purple Smoke)".
**Cinematography Direction**

Native 9:16: at most two people side by side; groups (elites, priestesses, guards) are always staged in depth, never in a line across the frame. Every shot line in the prompts carries a "Sides:" note for the top, middle and bottom thirds.
Faces in the centre third. Spears and dagger lines run vertically or diagonally into depth.
No slow sideways pans. Drama moves are slow push-ins, drifts, arcs, cranes and track-backs.
FAST beats, Marvel-style (15: 11, 25, 26, 32, 40, 42, 44, 46, 47, 51, 53, 58, 61, 67, 71): speed ramps, snap push-ins, fast track-outs and bullet time, exactly as written. The big ones: the leap with the extreme slow-motion sweep past the elites' faces (26), the mark flare (32), the bullet-time flight of the Serpent Dagger with the camera racing backward ahead of its tip (47), the slow-motion spark beat on the spear-wall (61), and the doors blast (71).
Static holds (9: 10, 14, 21, 45, 52, 60, 64, 68, 75) for the ward-light dying, Devika's question, his answer to Kaalini, the Leader's defiance, Kaalini's quiet threat, the spear-wall locking, the chant, the smoke under the doors and the guards' fear.
Screen line: Kaalini and her forces screen-left facing right; Agnivesh and Devika screen-right facing left, the same as Ep 4. The sanctum reverse and the corridor reverse are chosen so this holds.
Lenses: 24–32mm wides with deep focus, 40–50mm mediums, 75–85mm close-ups, 100mm for the inserts (the elite's grip, the smoke at his boots, the wrist, the dagger, the seal, the mask).

input.script_text: EXT. HARBOR BARRACKS GATE - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) Characters: Agnivesh, Devika, Royal Guard 3, Royal Sentries, Shadow Hound AGNIVESH stands outside the open gate, his spear planted in the ground, a dead SHADOW HOUND still impaled on it. The golden glow of the SWORD-SHAPED MARK fades beneath his sleeve. DEVIKA and the wounded ROYAL SENTRIES are just inside the gate. ROYAL GUARD 3 runs down the shore road toward them from the Rajmahal. ROYAL GUARD 3 (urgent, breathless) Rajkumar Agnivesh! Humare saath chhal hua hai! Humein is raaste par uljha kar Kaalini apne chhaya-daanavon ke saath Varuna-Dwaar se Rajmahal mein ghus gayi hai! The dead SHADOW HOUND slides off the spear and thuds onto the stones at Agnivesh's feet, dissolving into black smoke. Agnivesh wrenches the spear free. AGNIVESH (urgent, to Devika) Devika, mere saath chalo. Humein jaldi pahunchna hoga, anyatha bahut bada anarth ho jaayega! Agnivesh runs toward the Rajmahal, Devika close behind him. The ROYAL SENTRIES take their positions at the gate. EXT. SURYAGARH RAJMAHAL - COURTYARD - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) Characters: Agnivesh, Devika, Kaalini, Several Demon Elites The Rajmahal is Suryagarh’s fortified royal palace. High stone walls surround its courtyard. Carved sun emblems mark the walls and gates. Golden ward-lights are fixed above the gates and along the courtyard walls. The courtyard connects to the Surya Mandir, the grand corridor and the throne room. The main gates open on the south side; the steps of the Surya Mandir rise on the east side; on the north side, an arched entrance leads into the Grand Corridor and on to the throne room. KAALINI (30s, pale skin, obsidian hair pinned with serpent ornaments, midnight-blue warrior saree) walks through the open gates. Behind her march the DEMON ELITES: tall warriors in jagged black armour and horned masks, with glowing red eyes, carrying hooked spears. As Kaalini and the Demon Elites pass, the golden ward-lights flicker. Black smoke curls around each light, and they go dark one by one. Agnivesh and Devika rush into the courtyard through an inner passage on the west side and cut across her path at the centre of the courtyard. Agnivesh steps in front of Kaalini and levels his spear. The Demon Elites tighten their grip on their hooked spears, ready to strike. Devika steps up beside him and looks up at the darkening ward-lights. DEVIKA (uneasy, low) Yeh raksha-jyotiyan use rok kyun nahi rahin? Along the walls, the last sun-shaped lights die out. KAALINI (arrogant, venomous) Tumhare Suryagarh ka suraksha-chakra ab mere aage ek bujhi hui raakh hai, Balika. Tumhari prarthana vyarth hai aur tumhara devta vivash. Yahan ab keval mera raaj chalega! Agnivesh looks at the black smoke spreading across the courtyard stones. AGNIVESH (low, to Devika) Raksha-jyotiyan aise hi nahi bujh sakti... Avashya Surya Mandir ke kisi drohi ne bheetar se mantra-bhang kiya hai! Kaalini steps toward Agnivesh and faces him. The Demon Elites stand behind her, spears ready. KAALINI (cold, dismissive) Raasta chhodo, Rajkumar. Ab is mahal par andhkaar ka raaj hoga. AGNIVESH (firm, defiant) Jab tak Agnivesh jeevit hai, singhasan tak pahunchne ka tumhara ye sapna kabhi poora nahi hoga, Kaalini! Behind Kaalini, the Demon Elites point their spears at Agnivesh. Devika stands firm beside him. KAALINI (mocking) Tumhare pita ne tumhara naam mita diya hai, ab tumhara koi adhikaar nahi iss rajya pe. Ab tum keval is mitti par bhatakte hue ek bhikshuk ke samaan ho! Kaalini glances back at her Demon Elites and nods. They turn their hooked spears toward Devika. Devika steps back in fear. Agnivesh steps up beside her and shifts his spear away from Kaalini, pointing it at the Demon Elites. Devika stands firm at his side, unafraid. KAALINI (mocking, to her Demon Elites) Is parajit Rajkumar ka thoda dhyan rakhna, mere veero... Abhi-abhi Suryagarh se nishkaasit hua hai, komal dil hai bechare ka, kahin ro na pade! Kaalini strokes Agnivesh's cheek with mock affection, then walks away toward the Surya Mandir steps on the east side. Her Demon Elites stay, spears levelled at Agnivesh. DEVIKA (urgent) Woh Surya Mandir ki taraf ja rahi hai! Agnivesh replies to Devika in a low voice, his spear still pointed toward the Demon Elites. AGNIVESH (low, urgent) Devika, dev-sevikayon ko surakshit bahar le jao. Main Kaalini ko rokta hoon! Agnivesh pushes back his sleeve. The SWORD-SHAPED MARK on his wrist flares with a blinding golden light. The Demon Elites stagger back, shielding their eyes, and in the confusion Agnivesh and Devika slip away toward the Surya Mandir. INT. SURYA MANDIR - GARBHAGRIHA - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) Characters: Kaalini, Agnivesh, Devika, Temple Priestess Leader, Several Temple Priestesses, Several Demon Elites The SUN ALTAR stands at the centre of the sanctum, beneath the golden SUN MANDALA on the far wall. The main entrance is at the near end, a side arch opens on the left wall, and a small rear doorway is behind the altar. KAALINI strides into the sanctum as several TEMPLE PRIESTESSES in white-and-gold sarees form a circle around the SUN ALTAR. TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER (mid-40s, silver-streaked black hair in a jasmine bun, ivory-and-gold temple-silk drape, crystal mala) stands at the altar, at the head of the circle, and lifts a SACRED SCROLL over it. The priestesses raise brass prayer lamps. Their flames sputter black. The priestesses gasp. The TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER turns to the golden SUN MANDALA above the altar and prays. TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER (shaking, chanting loudly) Surya Dev, is vipatti, iss andhkaar ko Suryagarh se door kijiye! KAALINI (flat, contemptuous) Apne devta ko pukaarna band karo. Tumhari chikh-pukaar is garbhagriha ki deewaron se bahar nahi jayegi... Yahan ab sirf andhere ka raaj hoga, sirf andhere ka... The priestesses shrink back from Kaalini. AGNIVESH enters through a side arch, Devika behind him, and levels his spear at Kaalini's back. AGNIVESH (deep, forceful) Kaalini, inko haani pahunchaane ki sochna bhi mat. Yeh saare nirdosh hain. Kaalini turns slowly toward Agnivesh. The Demon Elites run in through the main entrance and level their spears at him from behind. KAALINI (mocking, measured) Nirdosh? Mat bhoolo, inki wajah se tumko apshagun kaha jaata hai! While Kaalini's eyes are on Agnivesh, Devika quietly leads the temple priestesses toward the rear doorway behind the altar. DEVIKA (low, urgent) Sab log is raaste se niklo, abhi! The TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER runs alongside Devika. At the rear doorway, she turns and calls back to Kaalini. TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER (voice breaking, defiant) Jab tak Surya vansh ki jyoti jal rahi hai, tumhara andhkaar nahi jeetega! Kaalini smiles. She draws her SERPENT DAGGER and hurls it. It slashes across the Priestess Leader's throat. A prayer lamp falls from her hand and rolls across the marble. The TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER collapses in the doorway. Agnivesh rushes to the rear doorway and sinks to one knee beside the fallen Priestess Leader. AGNIVESH (voice deep, restrained) Tumne ek rakshak ko nahi maara, Kaalini. Tumne Suryagarh ke pavitra man-mastisk mein vaar kiya hai. KAALINI (quiet, cruel) Abhi toh shuruaat hai, Rajkumar... Aaj tumhare devta, tumhara astitva, aur yeh poora Suryagarh mere andhere mein vileen ho jayega! Kaalini's dagger slithers back across the marble like a serpent, rises into the air, and she catches it. She licks the blood off its blade and turns to her Demon Elites. KAALINI (sharp, commanding) Mere veero, iss ashubh rajkumar ko chhodo aur aage badho! The Demon Elites turn and rush out of the temple toward the Grand Corridor. Kaalini follows them. Agnivesh stays on his knees beside the fallen Priestess Leader. Devika leads the surviving priestesses to safety. INT. RAJMAHAL - GRAND CORRIDOR - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) Characters: Agnivesh, Devika, Kaalini, Rajguru Badrinath, Several Demon Elites, Several Shadow Warriors, Several Royal Guards The long corridor runs from the courtyard arch to the throne-room doors at the far end, lined with sun-carved pillars, with royal guards posted before the doors. RAJGURU BADRINATH (bald, flame-and-lotus scalp tattoo, white beard, saffron robes) stands beside a sun-carved pillar near the corridor's entrance as Kaalini enters. RAJGURU BADRINATH lowers his eyes and steps aside as Kaalini and her Demon Elites pass. Agnivesh runs in. He spots RAJGURU BADRINATH near the pillar and stops short. AGNIVESH (strained, respectful) Rajguru Badrinath, aap yahan khade kyun hain? Use rokiye! Badrinath presses his prayer beads between both palms. He faces Agnivesh without lifting his head. RAJGURU BADRINATH (low, trembling) Maine hi Kaalini ka raasta khola tha. Agar main aisa nahi karta toh Timiraksha mere poore parivaar ko maar deta. Agnivesh takes one hard step toward him. AGNIVESH (deep, wounded) Aapne is rajya ki raksha ki kasam khaayi thi. Aur aapne apne parivaar ko bachane ke liye... Suryagarh ke hazaaron parivaaron ki jaan khatre mein daal di. Rajguru Badrinath lowers his head, unable to answer. Kaalini reaches the middle of the corridor. Her Demon Elites rush ahead, forcing the royal guards aside. Agnivesh charges after her, spear raised. Several Demon Elites turn and lock their hooked spears together, blocking his way. Agnivesh strikes the spear-wall, trying to break through, but they hold firm. Devika rushes into the corridor after guiding the surviving priestesses to safety. Kaalini kneels and cuts a mark into the marble with her serpent dagger. A black, blood-like seal spreads across the floor. KAALINI (low, chanting) Rakta se bandho. Surya ki shakti bujha do. DEVIKA (shouting to Agnivesh) Agnivesh! Uska rakta-bandhan bhang karo! Yeh singhasan ki shakti kheench rahi hai! Agnivesh pushes against the Demon Elites’ spears. AGNIVESH (straining, furious) Kaalini! Suryagarh ki mitti par tera yeh andhera kabhi nahi tikne doonga main! Kaalini stands and lifts her dagger for all to see. KAALINI (triumphant) Tumhare rajya ka ant ho chuka hai, rajya se nikaale hue Rajkumar! Timiraksha apna raj-bali lene aa raha hai! Black smoke spreads beneath the throne room doors. The guards at the far end step back in fear. AGNIVESH (desperate, fierce) Maharaj ko haani pahunchaane ki sochna bhi mat... Mere pita ko kuch hua toh tumhare poore andhere ke saamrajya ko jala ke raakh kar dunga! Kaalini turns toward the throne room and raises her hand. KAALINI (calling out, triumphant) Maharaj Someshwar… Timiraksha aapke liye aa raha hai! The throne-room doors BLAST off their hinges and crash across the corridor. The Demon Elites are thrown to the floor. Black smoke pours through the broken doorway. Tall, lean Shadow Warriors emerge from it, their bodies covered in shifting black armour. Violet eyes glow through their masks, and curved blades extend from their hands. The Demon Elites rise and gather behind Kaalini. Black smoke wraps around them. Their heavy armour changes shape, turning dark and smoke-like as they join the Shadow Warriors’ ranks. The royal guards step back in fear. One drops his spear. Devika moves behind a stone pillar. Agnivesh sees Kaalini near the open throne-room doorway. He breaks free of the spear-wall and runs toward her as the Shadow Warriors close in behind her. HARD CUT

④ Scene-by-Scene Emotion & Camera Intent
**Scene 1 — Harbor Barracks Gate (shots 1–7 / 31s)**

Emotional Target: Spent relief that turns to alarm.
Atmosphere: Sea mist, ash still settling, torches, the cracked dome faint above.
Camera Intent: Start low beside the planted spear so we pick up Ep 4's last image (1), the gateway (2) and Guard 3's report (3). The hound slides off the shaft (4) and dissolves into purple smoke as the camera cranes up with it (5); a slow arc around the pair for "mere saath chalo" (6); a high wide of them running up the shore road (7).
Spatial Staging: Agnivesh outside the gate (Reverse From the Gate Toward the Shore), Devika and the sentries in the gateway, Guard 3 arriving along the shore road in depth.
**Scene 2 — Rajmahal Courtyard (shots 8–33 / 105s)**

Emotional Target: Dread, then defiance under humiliation.
Atmosphere: Gold ward-light choking to purple smoke; cold moonlight; smoke low on the stones.
Camera Intent: Kaalini's intro close-up as she steps out of the smoke (8), a high wide of the elites marching in (9), the first ward-light dying (10). Agnivesh's run in (11, FAST) and the elite's grip insert (12). The standoff plays in singles and two-shots with the elites always in depth behind Kaalini; her taunts are held on arcs and push-ins; the extreme wide that cranes down to a medium for "Raasta chhodo" (20). The spears swing to Devika (25) and his leap (26). Kaalini leaves for the temple (29, East View to the Surya Mandir Steps); the mark flares (32) and they slip away (33).
Spatial Staging: Kaalini screen-left with the elites stacked behind her; Agnivesh and Devika screen-right. The temple steps lie east. The courtyard is "Suryagarh Rajdurg Gate" until the last lights die (8–14), then "Ward-Lights Dark (Purple Smoke)" (15–33, except 29).
**Scene 3 — Surya Mandir Garbhagriha (Inner Sanctum) (shots 34–55 / 87s)**

Emotional Target: Sacred calm broken, then grief.
Atmosphere: Amber lamps guttering out in thin black smoke, incense, the oculus moonbeam, the copper glow of the mandala.
Camera Intent: From the entrance (Inner Sanctum) for the ritual; Kaalini enters through purple smoke on the reverse (35, Reverse From the Altar Toward the Entrance); the reverse for Agnivesh's entrance and the trap (40–43); the rear doorway (Rear Doorway Behind the Altar) for the escape and the death (44–45, 48–51). The killing is restrained: a thin dark line, no spray, and the camera follows her down and stays on the rolling lamp.
Spatial Staging: Priestesses in a ring in depth around the altar; Kaalini mid-sanctum; Agnivesh in the side arch, screen-right; the elites in the main entrance behind him.
**Scene 4 — Grand Corridor (shots 56–76 / 81s)**

Emotional Target: Frustration and urgency, then horror.
Atmosphere: Torch pools and moonlight; the black seal with its blood-red glow; purple-and-black smoke from the throne room.
Camera Intent: The reverse toward the arch (Reverse Toward the Courtyard Arch) for every entrance (Kaalini past Badrinath 56, Agnivesh 58, Devika 62, 65), and the base (Grand Corridor) toward the doors for the striding reveal (57), the spear-wall (60–61), the seal (63–64) and the ritual. The blast (71) is the only shake; then the mask surfacing (72), the warriors stepping out (73) and the armour change (74, Shadow-Fused Armour) on the broken doorway (Throne-Room Doors Blasted Open). Badrinath is visible only in shot 56, as background: no reaction shot and no confrontation.
Spatial Staging: Kaalini mid-corridor; the spear-wall between her and Agnivesh; Royal Guard 2 and the palace guards by the doors in depth; Devika at the arch, then behind a pillar (75).
**Lighting Direction:** only practical, motivated sources. Harbour: moon and torches. Courtyard: gold ward-lights that die in thin purple smoke (they never relight), then moonlight. Sanctum: brass lamp towers and the oculus; the lamps gutter out in thin black smoke. Corridor: torch pools and high windows; the seal's blood-red glow (63–64); from 68, violet light and purple-and-black smoke from under the doors, then from the broken doorway. The bright exception is the mark's gold flare (32–33).

The priestesses raise brass prayer lamps. Their flames sputter black. The priestesses gasp. The TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER turns to the golden SUN MANDALA above the altar and prays. TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER (shaking, chanting loudly) Surya Dev, is vipatti, iss andhkaar ko Suryagarh se door kijiye! KAALINI (flat, contemptuous) Apne devta ko pukaarna band karo. Tumhari chikh-pukaar is garbhagriha ki deewaron se bahar nahi jayegi... Yahan ab sirf andhere ka raaj hoga, sirf andhere ka... The priestesses shrink back from Kaalini. AGNIVESH enters through a side arch, Devika behind him, and levels his spear at Kaalini's back. AGNIVESH (deep, forceful) Kaalini, inko haani pahunchaane ki sochna bhi mat. Yeh saare nirdosh hain. Kaalini turns slowly toward Agnivesh. The Demon Elites run in through the main entrance and level their spears at him from behind. KAALINI (mocking, measured) Nirdosh? Mat bhoolo, inki wajah se tumko apshagun kaha jaata hai! While Kaalini's eyes are on Agnivesh, Devika quietly leads the temple priestesses toward the rear doorway behind the altar. DEVIKA (low, urgent) Sab log is raaste se niklo, abhi! The TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER runs alongside Devika. At the rear doorway, she turns and calls back to Kaalini. TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER (voice breaking, defiant) Jab tak Surya vansh ki jyoti jal rahi hai, tumhara andhkaar nahi jeetega! Kaalini smiles. She draws her SERPENT DAGGER and hurls it. It slashes across the Priestess Leader's throat. A prayer lamp falls from her hand and rolls across the marble. The TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER collapses in the doorway. Agnivesh rushes to the rear doorway and sinks to one knee beside the fallen Priestess Leader. AGNIVESH (voice deep, restrained) Tumne ek rakshak ko nahi maara, Kaalini. Tumne Suryagarh ke pavitra man-mastisk mein vaar kiya hai. KAALINI (quiet, cruel) Abhi toh shuruaat hai, Rajkumar... RAJGURU BADRINATH (bald, flame-and-lotus scalp tattoo, white beard, saffron robes) stands beside a sun-carved pillar near the corridor's entrance as Kaalini enters. AGNIVESH (strained, respectful) Rajguru Badrinath, aap yahan khade kyun hain? Use rokiye! Badrinath presses his prayer beads between both palms. He faces Agnivesh without lifting his head. RAJGURU BADRINATH (low, trembling) Maine hi Kaalini ka raasta khola tha. Agar main aisa nahi karta toh Timiraksha mere poore parivaar ko maar deta. Agnivesh takes one hard step toward him. AGNIVESH (deep, wounded) Aapne is rajya ki raksha ki kasam khaayi thi. Aur aapne apne parivaar ko bachane ke liye... Suryagarh ke hazaaron parivaaron ki jaan khatre mein daal di. Yeh singhasan ki shakti kheench rahi hai! Agnivesh pushes against the Demon Elites’ spears. AGNIVESH (straining, furious) Kaalini! Suryagarh ki mitti par tera yeh andhera kabhi nahi tikne doonga main! Kaalini stands and lifts her dagger for all to see. KAALINI (triumphant) Tumhare rajya ka ant ho chuka hai, rajya se nikaale hue Rajkumar! Timiraksha apna raj-bali lene aa raha hai! Black smoke spreads beneath the throne room doors. KAALINI (calling out, triumphant) Maharaj Someshwar… Timiraksha aapke liye aa raha hai! The throne-room doors BLAST off their hinges and crash across the corridor. The Demon Elites are thrown to the floor. Black smoke pours through the broken doorway. Tall, lean Shadow Warriors emerge from it, their bodies covered in shifting black armour. output.section_text:
⑤ Sound Direction
Harbour: waves, torches, ragged breath; a long rising hiss as the hound dissolves. Courtyard: marching iron, a hiss as each ward-light dies, then near-silence for the taunts. Sanctum: a chanting hum that chokes off when the lamps die; a slowed, stretched hiss of steel and a heartbeat in the bullet time; the rolling lamp is the loudest sound in the scene. Corridor: echoing footsteps, iron on iron, the seal's wet spreading hiss under Kaalini's chant, the boom of the doors, blades sliding out of forearms.
Dialogue is Hindi in Devanagari, lip-synced, with only the named speaker talking. No music cue is written into the prompts; the score is the editor's.

TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER (voice breaking, defiant) Jab tak Surya vansh ki jyoti jal rahi hai, tumhara andhkaar nahi jeetega! Kaalini smiles. She draws her SERPENT DAGGER and hurls it. It slashes across the Priestess Leader's throat. A prayer lamp falls from her hand and rolls across the marble. The TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER collapses in the doorway. Agnivesh rushes to the rear doorway and sinks to one knee beside the fallen Priestess Leader. AGNIVESH (voice deep, restrained) Tumne ek rakshak ko nahi maara, Kaalini. Tumne Suryagarh ke pavitra man-mastisk mein vaar kiya hai. KAALINI (quiet, cruel) Abhi toh shuruaat hai, Rajkumar... Aaj tumhare devta, tumhara astitva, aur yeh poora Suryagarh mere andhere mein vileen ho jayega! Kaalini's dagger slithers back across the marble like a serpent, rises into the air, and she catches it. She licks the blood off its blade and turns to her Demon Elites. KAALINI (sharp, commanding) Mere veero, iss ashubh rajkumar ko chhodo aur aage badho! The Demon Elites turn and rush out of the temple toward the Grand Corridor. Kaalini follows them. Agnivesh stays on his knees beside the fallen Priestess Leader. Devika leads the surviving priestesses to safety. INT. RAJMAHAL - GRAND CORRIDOR - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) Characters: Agnivesh, Devika, Kaalini, Rajguru Badrinath, Several Demon Elites, Several Shadow Warriors, Several Royal Guards The long corridor runs from the courtyard arch to the throne-room doors at the far end, lined with sun-carved pillars, with royal guards posted before the doors. RAJGURU BADRINATH (bald, flame-and-lotus scalp tattoo, white beard, saffron robes) stands beside a sun-carved pillar near the corridor's entrance as Kaalini enters. RAJGURU BADRINATH lowers his eyes and steps aside as Kaalini and her Demon Elites pass. Agnivesh runs in. He spots RAJGURU BADRINATH near the pillar and stops short. AGNIVESH (strained, respectful) Rajguru Badrinath, aap yahan khade kyun hain? Use rokiye! Badrinath presses his prayer beads between both palms. He faces Agnivesh without lifting his head. RAJGURU BADRINATH (low, trembling) Maine hi Kaalini ka raasta khola tha. Agar main aisa nahi karta toh Timiraksha mere poore parivaar ko maar deta. Agnivesh takes one hard step toward him. AGNIVESH (deep, wounded) Aapne is rajya ki raksha ki kasam khaayi thi. Aur aapne apne parivaar ko bachane ke liye... Suryagarh ke hazaaron parivaaron ki jaan khatre mein daal di. Rajguru Badrinath lowers his head, unable to answer. Kaalini reaches the middle of the corridor. Her Demon Elites rush ahead, forcing the royal guards aside. Agnivesh charges after her, spear raised. Several Demon Elites turn and lock their hooked spears together, blocking his way. Agnivesh strikes the spear-wall, trying to break through, but they hold firm. Devika rushes into the corridor after guiding the surviving priestesses to safety. Kaalini kneels and cuts a mark into the marble with her serpent dagger. A black, blood-like seal spreads across the floor. KAALINI (low, chanting) Rakta se bandho. Surya ki shakti bujha do. DEVIKA (shouting to Agnivesh) Agnivesh! Uska rakta-bandhan bhang karo! Yeh singhasan ki shakti kheench rahi hai! Agnivesh pushes against the Demon Elites’ spears. AGNIVESH (straining, furious) Kaalini! Suryagarh ki mitti par tera yeh andhera kabhi nahi tikne doonga main! Kaalini stands and lifts her dagger for all to see. KAALINI (triumphant) Tumhare rajya ka ant ho chuka hai, rajya se nikaale hue Rajkumar! Timiraksha apna raj-bali lene aa raha hai! Black smoke spreads beneath the throne room doors. The guards at the far end step back in fear. AGNIVESH (desperate, fierce) Maharaj ko haani pahunchaane ki sochna bhi mat... Mere pita ko kuch hua toh tumhare poore andhere ke saamrajya ko jala ke raakh kar dunga! Kaalini turns toward the throne room and raises her hand. KAALINI (calling out, triumphant) Maharaj Someshwar… Timiraksha aapke liye aa raha hai! The throne-room doors BLAST off their hinges and crash across the corridor. The Demon Elites are thrown to the floor. Black smoke pours through the broken doorway. Tall, lean Shadow Warriors emerge from it, their bodies covered in shifting black armour. Violet eyes glow through their masks, and curved blades extend from their hands. The Demon Elites rise and gather behind Kaalini. Black smoke wraps around them. Their heavy armour changes shape, turning dark and smoke-like as they join the Shadow Warriors’ ranks. The royal guards step back in fear. One drops his spear. Devika moves behind a stone pillar. Agnivesh sees Kaalini near the open throne-room doorway. He breaks free of the spear-wall and runs toward her as the Shadow Warriors close in behind her. HARD CUT

output.manual_text:
IOC2 - DIRECTOR'S MANUAL (Ek Dulhan, Do Rajkumar) - 20 sec

1. THEME / PREMISE

A one-night marriage pact turns into a love triangle. Agnivesh offers Devika a vivaah taadpatra valid for only one night; Devika tests him with a soft confession; Ranvijay bursts in with his sword to stop it. Hook question for the audience: "Aakhir kiski hogi Devika?"

2. VISUAL STYLE & FRAMING

16:9 frame, all key action and faces kept inside the centre 9:16 safe area. Royal Indian period look, warm diya and mashaal light inside the Rajmahal Royal Chamber, deep reds and gold. Devika in red bridal vastra and jewellery; Agnivesh and Prince Ranvijay exactly as their approved character assets. Camera: smooth mechanical moves only (slow dolly, push-in, slow arc, tilt). No handheld, no whip-pans, no crash zooms. Every shot has gentle motion.

3. NARRATIVE STRUCTURE / PACING

0-5s: Setup. Shahi kaksh. Devika stands in bridal red. Agnivesh places the Marriage Scroll (taadpatra) in front of her. AGNIVESH: "Yeh vivaah keval ek raat ke liye hoga!"

5-11s: Intimacy. Devika steps close, takes his hand and places it on her waist. DEVIKA (soft voice): "Aur agar ek raat mein mujhe tumse prem ho gaya toh?"

11-16s: Rupture. Agnivesh looks into her eyes. The chamber door bangs open. Ranvijay stands in the doorway holding the Royal sword. RANVIJAY: "Devika! Tum mere bhai ki patni nahi ban sakti!"

16-20s: Hook. Hold on the three of them. NARRATOR: "Ek dulhan... do rajkumar! Aakhir kiski hogi Devika?"

4. SCENE-BY-SCENE EMOTION

0-5s: Agnivesh calm, guarded, formal. Devika composed, curious.

5-11s: Devika tender, daring; Agnivesh still, caught off guard.

11-16s: Shock. Ranvijay furious and possessive; Devika startled; Agnivesh turns to face him, protective.

16-20s: Tension frozen; triangle composition, Devika in the centre.

5. DIEGETIC SOUND

No music. SFX only: diya flame crackle, soft rustle of bridal fabric and bangles, scroll unrolling on wood, footsteps, heavy door slamming open, sword ring. Narrator voice-over only in 16-20s.

6. TRANSITIONS & CONTINUITY ANCHORS

One continuous location: Rajmahal Royal Chamber. The chamber door is the single entry point; Ranvijay enters only through it.

Positions lock: Agnivesh frame-left, Devika frame-right facing him for 0-11s; when the door opens Ranvijay appears in the background doorway, and in 16-20s the triangle reads Agnivesh left, Devika centre, Ranvijay right. Keep these sides the same in every shot.

Marriage Scroll stays where Agnivesh placed it for the rest of the IOC.

7. DERIVATIVE ASSET PRE-PLAN

Characters: Devika (bridal red look), Agnivesh, Prince Ranvijay. Location: Rajmahal Royal Chamber. Props: Marriage Scroll, Royal sword (in Ranvijay's hand). No other new assets needed.

8. NINNI'S DIRECTOR RULES (apply to every track)

- Dialogue is used exactly as written in the script, word for word. No rewording, no added or removed lines.

- Only the speaking character's mouth moves on their line; everyone else keeps their mouth closed.

- Every shot carries a Positions line; character sides and screen direction stay locked from shot to shot and from track to track. No character suddenly changes side, turns around or faces the wrong way.

- Characters look at the person they are talking to.

- The rendered location must match the location asset exactly, used as the background plate. No invented or redesigned layout, no mixing of conflicting location refs.

- Add every relevant existing asset (each character, location and prop in the shot) as a reference.

- Shot size and camera move follow the Storyboard Table. Shots, shot order and framing are not changed once approved.

- No eye glow on any character.

- Never regenerate an approved asset unless Ninni asks. Devika is never regenerated.

input.target_heading: 8. NINNI'S DIRECTOR RULES (apply to every track)

output.section_text:
8. NINNI'S DIRECTOR RULES (apply to every track)

- Dialogue is used exactly as written in the script, word for word. No rewording, no added or removed lines.

- Only the speaking character's mouth moves on their line; everyone else keeps their mouth closed.

- Every shot carries a Positions line; character sides and screen direction stay locked from shot to shot and from track to track. No character suddenly changes side, turns around or faces the wrong way.

- Characters look at the person they are talking to.

- The rendered location must match the location asset exactly, used as the background plate. No invented or redesigned layout, no mixing of conflicting location refs.

- Add every relevant existing asset (each character, location and prop in the shot) as a reference.

- Shot size and camera move follow the Storyboard Table. Shots, shot order and framing are not changed once approved.

- No eye glow on any character.

- Never regenerate an approved asset unless Ninni asks. Devika is never regenerated.

input.title: The Royal Darbar Awakening
input.script_text:

output.manual_text:
Director Creative Plan: The Royal Darbar Awakening
① Theme, Intent, and Narrative Core
Core Theme: Dynastic arrogance and public humiliation collapse the moment an outcast prince's dormant solar bloodline awakens to claim sovereign authority.
Emotional Through-Line:
Layer 1 (Subjugation & Derision): Crushing social intimidation, marked by heavy armored strides, a drawn blade cast across polished marble, and derisive sneers.
Layer 2 (Suppressed Stillness): Unyielding physical composure; lowered eyelids, relaxed shoulders, and complete muscular stillness absorbing hostile insults without flinching.
Layer 3 (Transcendent Vindication): Seismic inversion of power; dilated pupils, rising chin, and absolute stillness as the crown floats upward to crown true authority.
Parting Impression & Emotional Strategy: Absolute catharsis and breathless vindication. The audience must feel the sudden shift from suffocating humiliation to sovereign dominance, leaving a cliffhanger hook at the exact peak of divine reclamation.
② Visual Style and Frame Tone
Compositional Style (Vertical 9:16 Priority):
Symmetrical Center-Weighting: Agnivesh is anchored dead-center in the lower third of the vertical frame, creating an immovable pillar of calm against the volatile court.
Oppressive Diagonal Staging: Ranvijay is composed along a descending diagonal from upper-left to center, leaning into Agnivesh's space to project predatory entitlement.
Vertical Hierarchical Stacking: Someshwar is framed from a steep low angle looking up toward the elevated dais, stacking the throne, canopy, and crown above Agnivesh to emphasize institutional tyranny.
Three-Layer Spatial Separation:
Foreground: The skidding talwar blade scraping the floor tiles / dust falling from ceiling cornices (leading the viewer's eye into the confrontation).
Midground: The primary narrative combatants (Ranvijay leaning over Agnivesh; Someshwar's outstretched accusing hand; Agnivesh's glowing wrist).
Background: Towering carved sandstone pillars, rows of smirking courtiers, and heavy crimson silk drapes framing the elevated throne dais.
Camera Movement Preference:
Predominantly locked and deliberate camera moves driven strictly by narrative beats.
Rapid crane push-in on the flung blade to establish violent momentum.
Quick, disorienting handheld pan across mocking noblemen to simulate public encirclement.
Micro-push into Agnivesh's eyes to capture internal control.
Ascending vertical tilt tracking the levitating crown to formally break the court's physical hierarchy.
③ Narrative Structure and Pacing Plan
Narrative Mode Selection: Source-Faithful Microdrama Adaptation (7 continuous shots / 15 seconds, engineered around a tight humiliation-to-reversal structure).
Section Division:



Section	Name	Shots	Core Event	Emotional Intensity	Pacing
Section 1	The Public Humiliation	Shots 1–4	Ranvijay casts down his blade and demands subjugation; Someshwar denounces Agnivesh	Rising tension (5/10 → 8/10)	Rapid, punchy dialogue & hostile cuts
Section 2	The Solar Awakening	Shots 5–7	The wrist mark blazes; palace trembles; rajmukut levitates; Agnivesh claims his divine heritage	Climax & Reversal (9/10 → 10/10)	Kinetic punch-in expanding to suspended slow-motion
Emotional Curve: Sharp compression of space and mounting psychological hostility across Shots 1–4, breaking into an abrupt acoustic drop and expanding into sovereign majesty across Shots 5–7.
Fast / Slow Pacing: Shots 1–4 maintain rapid cutting on dialogue hits and mocking reactions (~2.5s per beat); Shots 5–7 slow physical motion down to capture telekinetic weight and structural vibration while maintaining high visual density.
Key Turning Points:
Turning Point 1 (Shot 4 to 5): Cut from Someshwar's condemning finger directly to an extreme close-up of Agnivesh's inner wrist, where dormant dermal fissures split open into radiant gold as ceiling dust jars loose above.
Turning Point 2 (Shot 5 to 6): The physical detachment of the rajmukut rising unassisted from the throne cushion into mid-air, reversing the monarch's supreme status without a weapon drawn.
Inter-Section Transition: Abrupt hard cut from court laughter to absolute dead silence punctuated by a seismic sub-bass tremor and the ignition of the solar mark.
④ Per-Scene Emotion and Frame Intent
Scene 1: Rajmahal Throne Room (Shots 1–7)
Emotional Target: The cruel triumph of court bullies collapsing into paralyzed dread as the outcast's motionless gaze forces the dynasty's sacred crown into airborne submission.
Atmosphere Direction: Oppressive, suffocating, volatile, transitioning abruptly into awe-inspiring, transcendent, and regal.
Shot Intent:
Shot 1 (Establishing Clash): Plunge from a high crane down to floor level as the heavy talwar slides toward the lens, instantly establishing Ranvijay's predatory entitlement and placing the audience at floor level.
Shot 2 (Verbal Assault): Low-angle medium close-up on Ranvijay's sneering mouth, cutting to eye-level medium close-up on Agnivesh's unblinking, relaxed expression to contrast rabid arrogance with unshakeable discipline.
Shot 3 (Court Mockery): Handheld lateral pan across smirking courtiers before pushing into Agnivesh's lowered eyes, emphasizing solitary isolation against an entire hostile institution.
Shot 4 (Patriarchal Condemnation): Over-the-shoulder perspective from behind Agnivesh facing the towering throne dais as Someshwar points downward, framing the crushing weight of royal law bearing down on him.
Shot 5 (Dermal Ignition & Tremor): Extreme macro close-up on the inner wrist as skin lines illuminate with golden fire, followed by a wide snap of swaying chandeliers and falling masonry to prove his bloodline commands the building itself.
Shot 6 (Crown Levitation): Slow-motion vertical tilt following the spinning gold crown lifting away from the empty throne, while courtiers physically stumble back into pillars.
Shot 7 (Sovereign Proclamation): Heroic low-angle close-up pushing into Agnivesh's raised eyes with the crown hovering above his head, cementing his reclamation of divine lineage on the cliffhanger line.
Spatial Narrative: Complete inversion of vertical power. The scene begins with Ranvijay and Someshwar dominating the upper two-thirds of the frame, looking down upon an isolated subject. It ends with the floating crown establishing a new apex above Agnivesh, forcing the throne and court to gaze upward.
Distance Design: Wide establishing slide (3m) → claustrophobic medium close-up confrontation (0.5m) → macro insert on wrist (zero distance) → wide structural shudder (10m) → heroic vertical close-up.
⑤ Sound Direction
Ambient Sound Design:
Heavy armored combat boots grinding on polished marble.
Ringing metallic slide and reverberant brassy clang of Damascus steel scraping stone flagstones.
Murmur of courtiers breaking into layered derisive snickers, whispers, and haughty guffaws.
Deep tectonic sub-bass shudder vibrating through stone footings.
Chandelier brass chains clashing and crystal pendants jingling violently overhead.
Fine masonry dust pattering onto silk robes and flagstones.
Shimmering crystalline ringing tone hummed by the spinning levitated crown.
Use of Silence: Complete cessation of all court laughter and murmurs at the exact opening frame of Shot 5; the ambient acoustic space goes dead silent for a fraction of a second, leaving only a solitary sub-bass heartbeat pulse before the seismic rumble erupts.
⑥ Transitions and Visual Continuity
Inter-Scene Transition Strategy: Rapid hard cuts between verbal strikes and listener reactions; axial jump-in from medium close-up to extreme macro insert for the awakening beat.
Inter-Section Transition Technique: Audio-motivated hard cut; the sudden drop into silence and the sharp high-frequency hum of the activating wrist mark bridges court ridicule into supernatural manifestation.
Visual Continuity Anchors:
Ranvijay's curved talwar remains stationary on the marble floor at Agnivesh's boots across Shots 1–5.
Agnivesh maintains locked vertical posture with arms resting at his sides, blue silk angrakha cuffs intact until the right sleeve shifts slightly to reveal the glowing mark in Shot 5.
Someshwar's outstretched right arm and pointing index finger maintain direction and eyeline alignment across Shots 4–5.
The rajmukut's starting position on the throne dais cushion before ascending vertically along the central architectural axis in Shot 6.
⑦ Derivative Asset Pre-Plan List



Asset Name	Derivative State	Reason / Section of Appearance
Royal Courtiers	formal courtier attire	Default on-screen formal courtier costume for the royal assembly throughout Shots 1–6.
Ranvijay's Sword	ground resting state	The curved Damascus talwar lying flat on polished marble after being flung down, visible in Shots 1–5.
(Note: Maharaja Someshwar, Prince Ranvijay, Agnivesh, Golden Crown, and Rajmahal Throne Room already possess complete locked derivative states covering all required costumes, wounded configurations, multi-view reference sheets, and camera angles.)

input.script_text:
1st ioc

SCENE 1 – SURYAGARH RAJMAHAL – NIGHT
VISUAL: Hazaaron saal purana Suryagarh ka bhavya rajmahal. Aasmaan mein bijli kadak rahi hai. Camera mahal ki oonchi deewaron se hota hua ek shahi kaksh mein pahunchta hai.

NARRATOR (Deep, Mysterious Voice):

“Hazaaron saal pehle... Suryagarh ke Maharaj Someshwar ne apni hi Maharani ke saath kiya ek aisa vishwasghaat... jisne poore Suryavansh ka bhagya badal diya!”

VISUAL: Maharaj Someshwar ek khoobsurat daasi ke kareeb khade hain. Raja uska haath pakadkar apne paas kheenchta hai. Dono ek-doosre ki aankhon mein dekhte hain. Camera dheere-dheere jalti hui mashaal ki taraf ghoomta hai.

NARRATOR:

“Maharani se chhipkar... Maharaj ne apni hi ek daasi ke saath bana liye avaidh sambandh!”

VISUAL: Samay beetne ka cinematic transition. Daasi apne garbh par haath rakhe khadi hai. Raja uske saamne chintit nazar aa raha hai.

DAASI (Khushi aur darr ke saath):

“Maharaj... main aapke bachche ki maa banne wali hoon!”

RAJA SOMESHWAR (Sakht Awaaz):

“Yeh baat rajmahal ki deewaron se baahar nahi jaani chahiye! Tumhara bachcha isi mahal mein palega... lekin uske janm ka satya kisi ko pata nahi chalega!”
SCENE 3 – GUPT PRASAV KAKSH – STORMY NIGHT
VISUAL: Andheri raat. Baahar bhayankar toofaan. Daasi ek shishu ko janm deti hai. Bachche ke rone ki awaaz poore kaksh mein goonj uthti hai.

NARRATOR:

“Lekin jis raat us daasi ne Maharaj ke bachche ko janm diya... usi raat Maharaj ne rach diya ek bhayankar shadyantra!”

VISUAL: Raja apni talwar nikaalta hai. Daasi apne navjaat bachche ko seene se laga leti hai.

DAASI (Darte hue):

“Maharaj! Aapne toh mere bachche ko apnaane ka vachan diya tha!”

RAJA SOMESHWAR (Krodh mein):

Layer 3 (Terrified Collapse): An invisible shockwave shatters the striking blade, throwing Maharaja Someshwar backward against the stone wall as Shishu opens glowing eyes.
